notes: Masculine noun 'number'. El primer número = the first issue (magazine). Número de teléfono. Número uno = number one. Sin número = countless. Montar un número = to make a scene.

examples.es: Escribe tu número de teléfono aquí.
examples.en: Write your phone number here.

notes: Masculine noun 'month'. El mes pasado/que viene = last/next month. A principios/finales de mes = at the start/end of the month. Mensual = monthly. Al mes = per month.

examples.es: El contrato empieza el mes que viene.
examples.en: The contract starts next month.

notes: Used to affirm precision or to agree emphatically with what someone said.

examples.es: Eso es exactamente lo que quiero.
examples.en: That is exactly what I want.

notes: Feminine noun 'fault/blame/guilt'. Tener la culpa = to be to blame. Por culpa de = because of/due to. Sin culpa = blameless. Echar la culpa = to blame.

examples.es: No es culpa mía, fue un accidente.
examples.en: It's not my fault, it was an accident.

notes: Adverb 'down/below/downstairs'. Más abajo = lower down. De arriba abajo = from top to bottom. ¡Abajo! = Down with...! Boca abajo = face down. Río abajo = downstream.

examples.es: El restaurante está justo abajo de nuestra oficina.
examples.en: The restaurant is right below our office.

notes: Feminine noun 'school'. Escuela primaria = primary school. Ir a la escuela = to go to school. Escuela de idiomas = language school. De la vieja escuela = old school.

examples.es: Los niños van a la escuela a pie.
examples.en: The children walk to school.

notes: Adjective/adverb 'strong/loud/hard'. Un abrazo muy fuerte = a big hug. Hablar fuerte = to speak loudly. Punto fuerte = strong point. Lo fuerte es = the incredible thing is.

examples.es: Necesitas ser fuerte en este momento.
examples.en: You need to be strong right now.

examples.es: El viento es muy fuerte hoy.
examples.en: The wind is very strong today.

notes: Neuter personal pronoun referring to a concept, idea, or situation (never a physical noun). Por ello = for that reason. Rarely used as subject; usually implied.

examples.es: No quiero hablar de ello.
examples.en: I don't want to talk about it.

notes: Feminine noun 'question'. Hacer una pregunta = to ask a question. Sin preguntas = without questions. Pregunta clave = key question. A buenas preguntas = good questions.

examples.es: Tengo una pregunta sobre el tema.
examples.en: I have a question about the topic.

notes: Indefinite article feminine plural 'some/a few/about'. Unas horas = a few hours. Unas cien personas = about a hundred people. Contrasts with algunas (some, more specific).

examples.es: Necesito unas horas para terminar el informe.
examples.en: I need a few hours to finish the report.

notes: Adverb 'behind/back/ago'. Hacia atrás = backwards. Quedarse atrás = to fall behind. Años atrás = years ago. Dar marcha atrás = to reverse/back down.

examples.es: No mires atrás, solo hacia adelante.
examples.en: Don't look back, only forward.

notes: Adjective 'bad/ill'. Shortens to mal before masc sing noun: mal tiempo. Estar malo = to be ill. Lo malo es = the bad thing is. ¡Mala suerte! = Bad luck!

examples.es: La situación está muy mala.
examples.en: The situation is very bad.

examples.es: El tiempo estuvo malo todo el fin de semana.
examples.en: The weather was bad all weekend.

notes: Used for ship/plane captains, army captains, and sports team captains.

examples.es: El capitán ordenó abandonar el barco.
examples.en: The captain ordered abandoning the ship.

examples.es: Es el capitán del equipo.
examples.en: He's the team captain.

notes: Masculine noun 'baby'. El bebé = the baby. Ropa de bebé = baby clothes. Comida de bebé = baby food. Also: nene/nena (baby, L.Am.), criatura (creature/baby).

examples.es: El bebé duerme en la habitación de al lado.
examples.en: The baby sleeps in the next room.

notes: Ordinal adjective/noun 'second'. El segundo = the second one. En segundo lugar = in second place/secondly. Un segundo = one second (wait). Segundo plato = main course.

examples.es: Llegué en segundo lugar.
examples.en: I came in second place.

examples.es: Dame un segundo, por favor.
examples.en: Give me a second, please.

notes: comparative of grande/viejo; as noun means adult or elder

examples.es: Mi hermano mayor tiene treinta años.
examples.en: My older brother is thirty years old.

examples.es: La mayor parte del trabajo está hecha.
examples.en: The greater part of the work is done.

notes: Feminine noun 'food/meal/lunch'. La comida del mediodía = lunch. Comida rápida = fast food. ¿Qué hay de comida? = What's for food/lunch? Comida basura = junk food.

examples.es: La comida española es deliciosa.
examples.en: Spanish food is delicious.

notes: Stem-changing o→ue/u verb 'to die'. Muero, mueres... Morirse de + emotion = to be dying of: me muero de risa. Morir de viejo = to die of old age.

examples.es: El personaje principal muere al final de la novela.
examples.en: The main character dies at the end of the novel.

notes: Irregular verb 'to know/meet (people/places)'. Conozco, conoces... Conocer a alguien = to know/meet someone. ¿Conoces Madrid? Contrasts with saber (facts/how-to).

examples.es: ¿Conoces a alguien en Madrid?
examples.en: Do you know anyone in Madrid?

notes: Adjective 'easy'. Es fácil + inf = it's easy to. Fácilmente = easily. Lo fácil = the easy thing. No es tan fácil = it's not that easy. Contrasts with difícil.

examples.es: Esta tarea es bastante fácil.
examples.en: This task is quite easy.

examples.es: No es tan fácil como parece.
examples.en: It is not as easy as it seems.

notes: Regular -er verb 'to eat'. Paradigm model for -er verbs. Comerse = to eat up (reflexive). ¿Qué comemos? ¿Quieres comer? Dar de comer = to feed.

examples.es: Comemos juntos todos los domingos.
examples.en: We eat together every Sunday.

notes: Note: vino is also the preterite 3rd-person singular of venir (he/she came) — context distinguishes the two.

examples.es: Pidieron una botella de vino tinto.
examples.en: They ordered a bottle of red wine.

notes: As noun (feminine): list. As adjective (lista/listo): clever, ready. ¿Estás listo? = Are you ready?

examples.es: Haz una lista de todo lo que necesitas.
examples.en: Make a list of everything you need.

notes: Followed by indicative or subjunctive depending on degree of certainty.

examples.es: Probablemente llegue tarde.
examples.en: I'll probably arrive late.

notes: Feminine noun 'room/bedroom'. Habitación individual/doble = single/double room. Compañero de habitación = roommate. Hacer la habitación = to tidy the room.

examples.es: Quiero reservar una habitación para dos noches.
examples.en: I'd like to book a room for two nights.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Tratar de + inf = to try to; tratar a alguien = to treat/deal with someone; tratarse de = to be about.

examples.es: Este libro trata de la guerra.
examples.en: This book is about the war.

notes: Regular -ar (spelling change c→qu before e) verb 'to look for/search'. Buscar a alguien = to look for someone. Ir a buscar = to go get/pick up. En busca de = in search of.

examples.es: Están buscando un apartamento en el centro.
examples.en: They are looking for a flat in the centre.

notes: Adverb 'neither/not either'. Yo tampoco = me neither. No + verb + tampoco or tampoco + verb. Contrasts with también (also). Ni esto ni aquello tampoco.

examples.es: Yo tampoco entiendo lo que pasó.
examples.en: I don't understand what happened either.

notes: Regular -ar verb. More literary/intense than querer for expressing love. Te amo is common in Latin America; Spain more often uses te quiero.

examples.es: Te amo con todo mi corazón.
examples.en: I love you with all my heart.

notes: Adjective/noun 'young/young person'. De joven = as a young person. Los jóvenes = young people. Un joven = a young man. Una joven = a young woman. Jovencito = youngster.

examples.es: Es una artista muy joven y talentosa.
examples.en: She is a very young and talented artist.

examples.es: Los jóvenes de hoy piensan diferente.
examples.en: Today's young people think differently.

notes: Un par de = a couple of / a pair of. As adjective (invariable): even number (número par). De par en par = wide open.

examples.es: Dame un par de minutos.
examples.en: Give me a couple of minutes.

notes: Derived from simple; often used to downplay or clarify.

examples.es: Simplemente di la verdad.
examples.en: Just tell the truth.

notes: Adjective/noun 'half/medium/means'. A medias = half done/jointly. Por medio de = by means of. En medio de = in the middle of. Medios de comunicación = media.

examples.es: Los medios de comunicación informaron del accidente.
examples.en: The media reported on the accident.

notes: As noun: sense (one of the five senses), meaning, direction. As adjective: heartfelt. Tiene sentido = it makes sense; sin sentido = meaningless.

examples.es: Lo que dices no tiene ningún sentido.
examples.en: What you're saying makes no sense.

notes: Adverb 'far'. Lejos de = far from. Estar lejos = to be far away. De lejos = from a distance/by far. Más lejos = further. A lo lejos = in the distance.

examples.es: La farmacia no está lejos, a cinco minutos.
examples.en: The pharmacy isn't far, five minutes away.

notes: takes masculine article in singular: el arma

examples.es: El policía portaba un arma reglamentaria.
examples.en: The police officer was carrying a regulation weapon.

notes: Adjective 'tall/high'. Adverb 'loudly'. En alto = held high/raised. Por todo lo alto = in grand style. Hablar en voz alta = to speak aloud. Alto el fuego = ceasefire.

examples.es: Mi padre es muy alto.
examples.en: My father is very tall.

examples.es: Los precios están demasiado altos.
examples.en: Prices are too high.

notes: Adjective 'small/little/young'. De pequeño = as a child/when young. El más pequeño = the youngest/smallest. Pequeño a pequeño = little by little. Fem: pequeña.

examples.es: El apartamento es pequeño pero acogedor.
examples.en: The apartment is small but cozy.

examples.es: Tenemos un pequeño problema.
examples.en: We have a small problem.

notes: Vulgar feminine noun 'whore/prostitute'. ¡Puta! = Damn!/Fuck! (exclamation). Hijo de puta = son of a bitch. De puta madre (vulgar, Spain) = awesome. Used as intensifier in many fixed expressions.

examples.es: ¡Puta, se me olvidó el pasaporte!
examples.en: Damn, I forgot my passport!

notes: Masculine noun 'dollar'. El dólar americano/canadiense/australiano. En dólares = in dollars. Cotización del dólar = dollar exchange rate. Pl: dólares.

examples.es: El precio es veinte dólares.
examples.en: The price is twenty dollars.

notes: Cardinal number 6.

examples.es: El partido empieza a las seis.
examples.en: The game starts at six.

notes: Feminine noun 'security/safety'. Seguridad social = social security. Con seguridad = certainly/safely. Medidas de seguridad = safety measures. Cuerpo de seguridad = security forces.

examples.es: La seguridad en el aeropuerto es muy estricta.
examples.en: Security at the airport is very strict.

notes: Strong expletive adjective. Maldito/maldita/malditos/malditas. Literally 'cursed'.

examples.es: ¡Maldito sea!
examples.en: Damn him!

examples.es: Ese maldito coche no arranca.
examples.en: That damn car won't start.

notes: Usually reflexive: preocuparse (por) = to worry (about). 'No te preocupes' = Don't worry.

examples.es: No te preocupes por eso.
examples.en: Don't worry about that.

examples.es: Me preocupa su salud.
examples.en: His health worries me.

notes: Feminine noun 'word'. Dar la palabra = to give the floor. Cumplir la palabra = to keep one's word. En pocas palabras = in a few words/in short. Juego de palabras = pun.

examples.es: No entiendo esa palabra — ¿qué significa?
examples.en: I don't understand that word — what does it mean?

notes: Highly versatile: quedar = to remain/be left; quedarse = to stay; quedar bien/mal = to look good/bad; quedar con alguien = to arrange to meet someone.

examples.es: Quedamos en el café a las cinco.
examples.en: We're meeting at the café at five.

notes: Feminine noun 'office'. En la oficina = at the office. Oficina de correos = post office. Trabajar en una oficina = to work in an office. Horas de oficina = office hours.

examples.es: Trabajo en una oficina en el centro de la ciudad.
examples.en: I work in an office in the city centre.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to kill'. Matarse = to kill oneself/work very hard. Matar el tiempo = to kill time. Me matas = you're killing me. Matar dos pájaros de un tiro.

examples.es: El veneno mató a las plantas del jardín.
examples.en: The poison killed the garden plants.

notes: Feminine noun 'bed'. Hacer la cama = to make the bed. Irse a la cama = to go to bed. Guardar cama = to stay in bed (ill). Camarero de cama = room service.

examples.es: Me voy a la cama, estoy agotado.
examples.en: I'm going to bed, I'm exhausted.

notes: Adverb/connector 'also/moreover/in addition/besides'. Además de = in addition to. Very common as paragraph/sentence connector. Además, hay que + inf.

examples.es: Es caro y además de mala calidad.
examples.en: It's expensive and moreover poor quality.

notes: Highly irregular verb 'to hear'. Oigo, oyes, oye, oímos, oís, oyen. ¡Oye! = Hey! (attention-getter). Oír hablar de = to hear about. Contrasts with escuchar (to listen actively).

examples.es: Oigo música, ¿viene de arriba?
examples.en: I can hear music — is it coming from upstairs?

notes: Stem-changing o→ue in stressed syllables. Recordar algo = to remember something; recordarle algo a alguien = to remind someone of something.

examples.es: No recuerdo dónde dejé las llaves.
examples.en: I don't remember where I left the keys.

notes: Almost always used as acerca de = about, regarding, concerning. Rarely used without de.

examples.es: Hablamos acerca del proyecto.
examples.en: We talked about the project.

notes: Feminine noun 'light'. La luz del sol = sunlight. Apagar/encender la luz = to turn off/on the light. Dar a luz = to give birth. A la luz de = in light of.

examples.es: Apaga la luz al salir, por favor.
examples.en: Turn off the light when you leave, please.

notes: Adjective 'correct/right/proper'. ¡Correcto! = Correct!/Right! Políticamente correcto = politically correct. Trato correcto = proper treatment. Incorrectamente.

examples.es: Tu respuesta es correcta.
examples.en: Your answer is correct.

examples.es: Eso no es el comportamiento correcto.
examples.en: That is not the correct behavior.

notes: Also used in exclamations: '¡Demonios!' = Damn it! 'Como un demonio' = like a demon.

examples.es: El sacerdote expulsó al demonio.
examples.en: The priest expelled the demon.

examples.es: ¡Demonios! Se me olvidó.
examples.en: Damn it! I forgot.

notes: Stem-changing o→ue/u verb 'to sleep'. Duermo, duermes, duerme... Dormirse = to fall asleep. Quedarse dormido = to fall/stay asleep. Dormir la siesta = to take a nap.

examples.es: El bebé duerme unas doce horas al día.
examples.en: The baby sleeps about twelve hours a day.

notes: Masculine noun 'place/site/space'. En este sitio = in this place. Hacer sitio = to make room. Sitio web = website. En ningún sitio = nowhere. En todos sitios = everywhere.

examples.es: Este sitio es perfecto para descansar.
examples.en: This spot is perfect for resting.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to help'. Ayudar a + inf = to help to do. Ayudarse = to help each other. ¿En qué puedo ayudarte? = How can I help you?

examples.es: ¿Puedo ayudarte con algo?
examples.en: Can I help you with something?

notes: Stem-changing e→i verb 'to get/obtain/achieve/manage'. Consigo, consigues... Conseguir + inf = to manage to. No consigo entenderlo = I can't figure it out.

examples.es: Por fin conseguí entradas para el concierto.
examples.en: I finally got tickets for the concert.

notes: Masculine noun 'husband'. Mi marido = my husband. El marido = the husband. More colloquial than esposo in Spain. Exmarido = ex-husband.

examples.es: Su marido trabaja en el extranjero.
examples.en: Her husband works abroad.

notes: Feminine noun 'peace'. En paz = in peace. Hacer las paces = to make peace/make up. Dejar en paz = to leave alone. Descansar en paz = to rest in peace.

examples.es: Necesito un poco de paz y tranquilidad.
examples.en: I need a bit of peace and quiet.

notes: Gender-invariant noun/adjective: el/la idiota. Informal, mildly offensive.

examples.es: No seas idiota.
examples.en: Don't be an idiot.

examples.es: Ese idiota me arruinó el día.
examples.en: That idiot ruined my day.

notes: Masculine noun 'plan'. Tener planes = to have plans. En plan de = as a way of/in the style of (colloq. Spain). Cambiar de planes = to change plans. Sin planes = free/no plans.

examples.es: ¿Tienes planes para el fin de semana?
examples.en: Do you have plans for the weekend?

notes: Comparative and superlative of malo/mal (worse/worst). Invariable for gender; peores in plural. Lo peor = the worst thing.

examples.es: Lo peor ya ha pasado.
examples.en: The worst is already over.

notes: Masculine noun 'village/town/people (nation)'. El pueblo = the village/the people. Pueblo natal = home village. Gente del pueblo = village folk. El pueblo español = the Spanish people.

examples.es: Pasamos el verano en un pueblo de montaña.
examples.en: We spent the summer in a mountain village.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: vivo/viva/vivos/vivas. Estar vivo = to be alive. Also: vivid, bright (colour), clever/sharp (person).

examples.es: Afortunadamente, todos salieron vivos del accidente.
examples.en: Fortunately, everyone came out of the accident alive.

notes: Exclamatory use of the 3rd-person present of bastar (to be enough). ¡Basta ya! = That's enough! / Stop it! Often used to end an argument.

examples.es: ¡Basta! No quiero escuchar más.
examples.en: Enough! I don't want to hear any more.

notes: Meanings: step (physical), pace, pass (mountain pass), crossing (zebra crossing). Paso a paso = step by step. Dar un paso = to take a step.

examples.es: Da un paso hacia adelante.
examples.en: Take a step forward.

notes: Feminine noun 'music'. Escuchar música = to listen to music. Música clásica/pop/rock = classical/pop/rock music. Músico = musician. Poner música = to put on music.

examples.es: Escucho música mientras trabajo.
examples.en: I listen to music while I work.

notes: Fixed adverb meaning last night. The exact Spanish counterpart of 'last night'; esta noche = tonight.

examples.es: Anoche no pude dormir.
examples.en: Last night I couldn't sleep.

notes: Masculine noun 'country'. El País Vasco = the Basque Country. El país de origen = the home country. De país en país = from country to country. Paisano = fellow countryman.

examples.es: Visitó más de veinte países en dos años.
examples.en: He visited more than twenty countries in two years.

notes: Masculine noun 'king'. Los Reyes = the King and Queen. Los Reyes Magos = the Three Wise Men (Epiphany). El Rey = the King. Reina = queen. Real = royal.

examples.es: El rey firmó el decreto.
examples.en: The king signed the decree.

notes: Used to apologise or to get someone's attention politely. Also a noun meaning pardon/forgiveness.

examples.es: Perdón, ¿me puede ayudar?
examples.en: Excuse me, can you help me?

notes: Meanings: lack, absence, fault, foul (sport). Hacer falta = to be needed. Sin falta = without fail.

examples.es: Aquí hace falta más luz.
examples.en: More light is needed here.

notes: Cardinal number 10.

examples.es: Espera diez minutos.
examples.en: Wait ten minutes.

notes: Core verb with many uses: to carry/take (objects), to wear (clothes), to spend time doing something (llevo dos horas esperando = I've been waiting two hours).

examples.es: ¿Puedes llevar esto al coche?
examples.en: Can you take this to the car?

notes: Masculine noun 'hospital'. Ir al hospital = to go to hospital. Ingresar en el hospital = to be admitted to hospital. Hospital de campaña = field hospital.

examples.es: Me llevaron al hospital de urgencias.
examples.en: They took me to the emergency hospital.

notes: Literal: fire, flame. Also used idiomatically: pedir fuego = to ask for a light (cigarette); fuegos artificiales = fireworks.

examples.es: El fuego se extendió rápidamente.
examples.en: The fire spread quickly.

notes: Highly irregular verb 'to put/place/set'. Pongo, pones, pone... Ponerse = to become/put on. Poner en marcha = to start up. Ponerse a + inf = to start doing.

examples.es: Pon la mesa, que la cena está lista.
examples.en: Set the table, dinner is ready.

notes: Feminine noun 'street'. En la calle = in the street/outside. Calle arriba/abajo = up/down the street. Echar a la calle = to throw out. Vivir en la calle = to be homeless.

examples.es: Vivo en esta calle desde pequeño.
examples.en: I've lived on this street since I was small.

notes: Acabar de + inf = to have just done sth (Acabo de llegar = I've just arrived). Acabar con = to put an end to. Acabarse = to run out. Regular -ar verb.

examples.es: ¿Cuándo vas a acabar ese libro?
examples.en: When are you going to finish that book?

notes: Feminine noun 'test/proof/trial'. A prueba de = proof against. Poner a prueba = to put to the test. Prueba de acceso = entrance test. Dar pruebas = to provide evidence.

examples.es: No hay pruebas suficientes para condenarle.
examples.en: There is not enough evidence to convict him.

notes: Adjective 'incredible/unbelievable'. ¡Increíble! = Incredible! Es increíble que + subj. Lo increíble es = the incredible thing is. Increíblemente = incredibly.

examples.es: El paisaje era absolutamente increíble.
examples.en: The landscape was absolutely incredible.

examples.es: Tiene una memoria increíble.
examples.en: He has an incredible memory.

notes: also means royal

examples.es: El problema es completamente real.
examples.en: The problem is completely real.

examples.es: La familia real asistió al evento.
examples.en: The royal family attended the event.

notes: Masculine noun 'book'. Leer un libro = to read a book. Libro de texto = textbook. Llevar los libros = to keep the books (accounting). Libro de reclamaciones = complaints book.

examples.es: Estoy leyendo un libro muy interesante.
examples.en: I'm reading a very interesting book.

notes: Gender affects meaning: el orden = order (arrangement, sequence); la orden = command/order (instruction). Plural órdenes for both.

examples.es: Sigue las órdenes del médico.
examples.en: Follow the doctor's orders.

notes: Adjective 'special'. Nada especial = nothing special. En especial/especialmente = especially. Edición especial = special edition. Efecto especial = special effect.

examples.es: Hoy es un día muy especial.
examples.en: Today is a very special day.

examples.es: Tiene algo especial que no puedo describir.
examples.en: He has something special that I can't describe.

notes: Possessive pronoun 'mine (fem)'. La mía = mine (fem). ¡Madre mía! = My goodness! Cosa mía = my business. ¡Esta es la mía! = This is my chance!

examples.es: Esa silla roja es la mía.
examples.en: That red chair is mine.

notes: Masculine noun 'coffee/café'. Tomar un café = to have a coffee. Café solo/con leche = black coffee/white coffee. Café Internet = internet café. Color café = brown (L.Am.).

examples.es: ¿Tomamos un café después de comer?
examples.en: Shall we have a coffee after lunch?

notes: Adjective 'hard/tough/harsh'. Adverb: trabajar duro = to work hard. Golpe duro = hard blow. Vida dura = tough life. Estar duro = to be stale/hard (food).

examples.es: Ha sido un año muy duro para todos.
examples.en: It has been a very tough year for everyone.

examples.es: El pan está duro, ya tiene días.
examples.en: The bread is hard, it's been days.

notes: stem-changing: e→ie (empiezo); z→c before e (empecé)

examples.es: La película empieza a las ocho y media.
examples.en: The film starts at half past eight.

notes: Latin American variant; Spain uses fuera

examples.es: Los niños están jugando afuera.
examples.en: The children are playing outside.

notes: Masculine noun 'dog'. Vida de perros = a dog's life. Hacer el perro = to act the fool. Tiempo de perros = dreadful weather. Perro callejero = stray dog. Fem: perra.

examples.es: El perro ladra cada vez que suena el timbre.
examples.en: The dog barks every time the doorbell rings.

notes: also used as a term of endearment (darling)

examples.es: El cielo está despejado y hace mucho sol.
examples.en: The sky is clear and it's very sunny.

notes: Masculine noun 'trip/journey'. Hacer un viaje = to take a trip. Buen viaje = have a good trip. Agencia de viajes = travel agency. De viaje = travelling/away on a trip.

examples.es: El viaje a Japón duró más de doce horas.
examples.en: The trip to Japan lasted more than twelve hours.

notes: Adverb of place meaning behind. Used with de: detrás de la puerta = behind the door.

examples.es: El jardín está detrás de la casa.
examples.en: The garden is behind the house.

notes: Primary meaning: room (any room). Also: quarter (1/4). Son las tres y cuarto = it's quarter past three.

examples.es: Mi cuarto es pequeño pero cómodo.
examples.en: My room is small but comfortable.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Preguntar por = to ask about/after someone. Distinguish from pedir (to ask for) and hacer una pregunta (to ask a question).

examples.es: Me preguntó si estaba bien.
examples.en: He asked me if I was okay.

notes: free in the sense of freedom or availability; gratis = free of charge

examples.es: En mi tiempo libre me gusta leer.
examples.en: In my free time I like to read.

examples.es: Eres libre de tomar tu propia decisión.
examples.en: You are free to make your own decision.

notes: Relative pronoun. Usually preceded by article: el cual, la cual, los cuales, las cuales — used for added clarity or in formal registers. Cuál (with accent) is interrogative.

examples.es: El informe, el cual presentamos ayer, fue aprobado.
examples.en: The report, which we presented yesterday, was approved.

notes: stem-changing: o→ue (sueno) in stressed syllables; also used pronominally (sonarse) in some dialects

examples.es: El teléfono suena a las ocho.
examples.en: The phone rings at eight.

examples.es: Esa idea suena bien.
examples.en: That idea sounds good.

notes: stem-changing: u→ue (juego)

examples.es: Los niños juegan en el parque después del colegio.
examples.en: The children play in the park after school.

notes: Masculine noun 'change/exchange'. En cambio = on the other hand. A cambio de = in exchange for. Cambio climático = climate change. Tipo de cambio = exchange rate.

examples.es: El cambio de trabajo le vino muy bien.
examples.en: The change of job did him a lot of good.

notes: Feminine noun 'film/movie'. Ver una película = to watch a film. Película de terror/acción = horror/action film. Director de cine = film director. ¡Qué película! = What a story!

examples.es: Esta película ganó tres premios Oscar.
examples.en: This film won three Academy Awards.

notes: Note irregular plural spelling: millón → millones. When followed by a noun: un millón de personas (de is required).

examples.es: Hay más de un millón de personas en esa ciudad.
examples.en: There are more than a million people in that city.

notes: The rest/remainder. Plural 'restos' can mean remains (ruins, human remains). 'El resto del día' = the rest of the day.

examples.es: El resto puede irse.
examples.en: The rest can go.

examples.es: Los restos del naufragio fueron hallados.
examples.en: The remains of the shipwreck were found.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: extraño/extraña/extraños/extrañas. Also used as a noun (un extraño = a stranger). Qué extraño = how strange.

examples.es: Hay algo extraño en esa casa.
examples.en: There's something strange about that house.

notes: Feminine: presidenta. Used for president of a country, company chairman, etc.

examples.es: El presidente anunció nuevas medidas.
examples.en: The president announced new measures.

examples.es: Fue elegida presidenta de la empresa.
examples.en: She was elected chairperson of the company.

notes: mass noun, no plural

examples.es: Necesita comprar ropa para el invierno.
examples.en: She needs to buy clothes for winter.

notes: stem-changing: e→ie (pierdo)

examples.es: Perdió el tren por llegar tarde.
examples.en: He missed the train because he arrived late.

notes: Gender-common (el/la agente). Covers law enforcement officer, real-estate agent, travel agent, and grammatical agent.

examples.es: El agente le pidió la documentación.
examples.en: The officer asked him for his documents.

notes: mass noun, no plural

examples.es: ¿Tiene información sobre los vuelos a Roma?
examples.en: Do you have information about flights to Rome?

notes: Two meanings: (1) strange/odd, (2) rare/uncommon. Qué raro = how odd/strange. Rara vez = rarely.

examples.es: Qué raro, no contesta el teléfono.
examples.en: How strange, he's not answering the phone.

notes: As adjective: general, overall, widespread. As noun (el general): military general. En general = in general, generally.

examples.es: En general, estoy de acuerdo contigo.
examples.en: In general, I agree with you.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to use'. Usar + noun. De uso = for use. En uso = in use. Usado = used/second-hand. Useful synonym: utilizar (more formal).

examples.es: ¿Usas el coche para ir al trabajo?
examples.en: Do you use the car to get to work?

notes: Adjective 'perfect'. ¡Perfecto! = Perfect! En perfecto estado = in perfect condition. El pretérito perfecto = the perfect tense. Imperfecto = imperfect.

examples.es: El momento fue perfecto.
examples.en: The moment was perfect.

examples.es: Nadie es perfecto.
examples.en: Nobody is perfect.

notes: As adjective: straight, upright, right (direction). As noun (el derecho): law (the subject) or a right (legal/moral). Todo recto = straight ahead.

examples.es: Tienes derecho a saber la verdad.
examples.en: You have the right to know the truth.

notes: Adverb/noun 'yesterday'. Ayer por la mañana/tarde/noche = yesterday morning/afternoon/evening. El ayer = the past/yesterday (noun). Antes de ayer = the day before yesterday.

examples.es: Ayer tuvimos una reunión muy larga.
examples.en: Yesterday we had a very long meeting.

notes: Always with article: los/las demás = the others/the rest. Lo demás = the rest (of it). Invariable for gender; takes plural verb.

examples.es: Los demás ya se han ido.
examples.en: The others have already left.

notes: Usually plural las noticias = the news (broadcast). Una noticia = a piece of news. False friend: notice in English ≠ noticia.

examples.es: ¿Has oído las últimas noticias?
examples.en: Have you heard the latest news?

notes: Also used as adj: crimen asesino. Feminine: asesina. Asesinato = murder (noun).

examples.es: La policía atrapó al asesino.
examples.en: The police caught the murderer.

examples.es: El asesino fue condenado a cadena perpetua.
examples.en: The murderer was sentenced to life in prison.

notes: Masculine noun 'control/checkpoint'. Bajo control = under control. Perder el control = to lose control. Control de pasaportes = passport control. Fuera de control = out of control.

examples.es: El control de calidad es esencial.
examples.en: Quality control is essential.

notes: Strong hatred or intense dislike. Related verb: odiar (already in curated).

examples.es: El odio solo destruye.
examples.en: Hatred only destroys.

examples.es: Siento un odio terrible hacia la injusticia.
examples.en: I feel a terrible hatred towards injustice.

notes: As feminine noun: forehead. As masculine noun: front (military, political, weather). Frente a = opposite/in front of (preposition).

examples.es: El hotel está justo enfrente de la estación.
examples.en: The hotel is right opposite the station.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Describes something or someone as fun/entertaining. Qué divertido = how fun! Divertirse = to have fun.

examples.es: Fue una noche muy divertida.
examples.en: It was a very fun night.

notes: Masculine noun 'group'. En grupo = as a group. Grupo de amigos = group of friends. Grupo musical = musical group/band. Trabajo en grupo = group work.

examples.es: Trabaja en un grupo de investigación.
examples.en: She works in a research group.

notes: Broad word for any matter, affair, or subject. Asuntos exteriores = foreign affairs. No es asunto tuyo = It's none of your business.

examples.es: Hay un asunto urgente que tratar.
examples.en: There is an urgent matter to deal with.

notes: Used for text messages, voicemails, and broader communications. Dejar un mensaje = to leave a message.

examples.es: Te mandé un mensaje pero no respondiste.
examples.en: I sent you a message but you didn't reply.

notes: Adverb of place: on top, above, overhead. With de: encima de = on top of. Colloquial: on top of that, to make matters worse.

examples.es: El libro está encima de la mesa.
examples.en: The book is on top of the table.

notes: Feminine noun. Prestar atención = to pay attention. ¡Atención! = Attention! / Watch out! Used also in customer service context.

examples.es: Presta atención a lo que te digo.
examples.en: Pay attention to what I'm telling you.

notes: Adjective 'different'. Diferente a/de = different from. Ser diferente = to be different. Todo es diferente = everything is different. Diferentemente = differently.

examples.es: Tenemos gustos muy diferentes.
examples.en: We have very different tastes.

examples.es: Mañana será un día diferente.
examples.en: Tomorrow will be a different day.

notes: Hacer daño = to hurt/harm. Hacerse daño = to hurt oneself. Also used in legal/insurance contexts: daños y perjuicios = damages.

examples.es: El granizo causó daños en los cultivos.
examples.en: The hail caused damage to the crops.

notes: Regular -er verb. Usually impersonal: sucede que… = it happens that… ¿Qué sucede? = What's happening? Synonym: pasar, ocurrir.

examples.es: ¿Sabes lo que sucedió aquí?
examples.en: Do you know what happened here?

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to change'. Cambiar de + noun = to change: cambiar de idea. Cambiarse = to change clothes. En cambio = on the other hand. Sin cambio = no change.

examples.es: Necesito cambiar euros a libras.
examples.en: I need to change euros into pounds.

notes: Adjective 'next/following'. El siguiente = the next one. A la mañana siguiente = the following morning. Lo siguiente = the following thing. Siguiente, por favor = next, please.

examples.es: El siguiente en la lista es Pedro.
examples.en: The next one on the list is Pedro.

examples.es: Léeme el siguiente párrafo, por favor.
examples.en: Read me the following paragraph, please.

notes: Conjunction 'but rather/but instead'. Replaces a negated element: no A sino B. Sino que + clause. Not to confuse with si no (if not). No solo... sino también.

examples.es: No es difícil, sino diferente.
examples.en: It's not difficult, but rather different.

notes: also used as adjective meaning medical

examples.es: El médico me recomendó descansar unos días.
examples.en: The doctor recommended that I rest for a few days.

notes: Feminine noun 'mouth'. Boca abajo/arriba = face down/up. Boca de metro = metro entrance. Hablar por boca de = to speak through. Agua en boca = mum's the word.

examples.es: Abre la boca — el dentista quiere mirarte los dientes.
examples.en: Open your mouth — the dentist wants to look at your teeth.

notes: Masculine noun 'error/mistake'. Cometer un error = to make a mistake. Por error = by mistake. Error garrafal = terrible blunder. Sin error = without error. ¡Error! = Wrong!

examples.es: Cometió un error al calcular el presupuesto.
examples.en: He made an error when calculating the budget.

notes: Adverb 'never/ever' (stronger than nunca). Nunca jamás = never ever. Lo mejor/peor que jamás he visto. ¡Jamás! = Never! Can mean 'ever' in questions.

examples.es: Jamás he visto nada igual.
examples.en: I have never seen anything like it.

notes: Adjective 'long'. A lo largo de = throughout/along. De largo = (measuring) long. En largo/a lo largo = lengthwise. ¡Largo de aquí! = Get out of here!

examples.es: El viaje fue muy largo y cansado.
examples.en: The journey was very long and tiring.

examples.es: Tiene el pelo largo y oscuro.
examples.en: She has long, dark hair.

notes: Core meanings: pity/shame (¡Qué pena! = What a shame!), sorrow/grief, and penalty/punishment (pena de muerte = death penalty).

examples.es: ¡Qué pena que no puedas venir!
examples.en: What a shame you can't come!

notes: Feminine noun 'voice'. En voz alta/baja = aloud/softly. A una voz = unanimously. Voz activa/pasiva = active/passive voice. Dar voz a = to give voice to.

examples.es: Tiene una voz preciosa para cantar.
examples.en: She has a beautiful singing voice.

notes: Masculine noun/adjective 'future'. En el futuro = in the future. A futuro = going forward. El futuro de indicativo = the future tense. En un futuro próximo = in the near future.

examples.es: Nadie sabe lo que nos depara el futuro.
examples.en: Nobody knows what the future holds for us.

notes: As noun: secret. As adjective: secret/secretive (agente secreto). Guardar un secreto = to keep a secret. En secreto = in secret.

examples.es: Prometió guardar el secreto.
examples.en: He promised to keep the secret.

notes: Refers to the bathroom/toilet room as well as the act of bathing.

examples.es: ¿Dónde está el baño?
examples.en: Where is the bathroom?

notes: Cardinal number 1000. Also used loosely to mean 'thousands' (a lot).

examples.es: Hay mil razones para sonreír.
examples.en: There are a thousand reasons to smile.

notes: Girlfriend or bride (at a wedding). Novio = boyfriend/groom. The word does not distinguish casual dating from serious relationship.

examples.es: Lleva tres años con su novia.
examples.en: He's been with his girlfriend for three years.

notes: feminine singular of propio; used attributively and predicatively; also appears in pronominal/neuter forms (lo propio).

examples.es: Ella tiene su propia habitación.
examples.en: She has her own room.

examples.es: Es una forma propia de expresarse.
examples.en: It's a characteristic way of expressing oneself.

notes: also means sleep

examples.es: Tuve un sueño muy raro anoche.
examples.en: I had a very strange dream last night.

notes: Feminine noun 'strength/force/power'. A la fuerza = by force/necessarily. Con fuerza = strongly. Fuerzas armadas = armed forces. Sacar fuerzas = to find strength.

examples.es: No tengo fuerzas para seguir.
examples.en: I don't have the strength to carry on.

notes: Formal/written alternative to los dos. Agrees in gender: ambos/ambas. Always refers to two things or people already mentioned.

examples.es: Ambos candidatos tienen buenas ideas.
examples.en: Both candidates have good ideas.

notes: Masculine noun 'pain/ache/grief'. Dolor de cabeza/espalda = headache/backache. Sin dolor = painless. Con mucho dolor = with great sorrow. Matar el dolor = to kill the pain.

examples.es: Siento un dolor fuerte en el pecho.
examples.en: I feel a sharp pain in my chest.

notes: a verb like gustar: commonly used with indirect object pronouns (me encanta, nos encantan); can be reflexive in rare uses (encantarse).

examples.es: Me encanta esa canción.
examples.en: I love that song.

examples.es: A ellos les encantan las montañas.
examples.en: They love the mountains.

notes: Feminine noun 'age'. ¿Qué edad tienes? = How old are you? De mi edad = my age. La tercera edad = old age/the elderly. Edad de oro = golden age. Mayor de edad = of age.

examples.es: ¿Qué edad tienes?
examples.en: How old are you?

notes: Masculine noun. Foot (body part). De pie = standing up. A pie = on foot. Al pie de la letra = to the letter (exactly).

examples.es: Me duele el pie derecho.
examples.en: My right foot hurts.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: negro/negra/negros/negras. Colour black. As noun: Black person. Mercado negro = black market.

examples.es: Quiero el café negro, sin azúcar.
examples.en: I want black coffee, no sugar.

notes: To win (a competition) or to earn (money). Ganarse la vida = to make a living.

examples.es: Nuestro equipo ganó el partido.
examples.en: Our team won the match.

notes: Aire libre = outdoors; al aire = in the open; also means 'air conditioning' colloquially in Spain.

examples.es: Necesito salir a tomar un poco de aire.
examples.en: I need to go out and get some fresh air.

notes: Asesinato = murder (the act); asesino = murderer; asesinar = to murder.

examples.es: El detective investigó el asesinato.
examples.en: The detective investigated the murder.

notes: Three main meanings: appointment (medical/business), date (romantic), quotation. Tener una cita = to have an appointment or a date.

examples.es: Tengo una cita con el médico a las tres.
examples.en: I have a doctor's appointment at three.

notes: Masculine noun 'system'. Sistema nervioso/solar/educativo. Sistema operativo = operating system. Por sistema = systematically. Fuera del sistema = outside the system.

examples.es: El sistema educativo necesita más inversión.
examples.en: The education system needs more investment.

notes: Taste (sense) or pleasure. Mucho gusto = nice to meet you. Con mucho gusto = with pleasure. A gusto = comfortable/at ease.

examples.es: Mucho gusto en conocerte.
examples.en: Nice to meet you.

notes: Before noun: pitiful/unfortunate (el pobre hombre = the poor man). After noun: financially poor (una familia pobre). As noun: a poor person.

examples.es: El pobre chico no sabía qué hacer.
examples.en: The poor guy didn't know what to do.

notes: Noun: negociación = negotiation. Very common in business contexts.

examples.es: Vamos a negociar el precio.
examples.en: We're going to negotiate the price.

examples.es: Las partes están negociando un acuerdo.
examples.en: The parties are negotiating an agreement.

notes: Feminine noun 'mind'. Tener en mente = to have in mind. Venir a la mente = to come to mind. Mente abierta = open mind. Cambiar de opinión/mente. Cerrar la mente = to close one's mind.

examples.es: Ten la mente abierta.
examples.en: Keep an open mind.

notes: Possessive pronoun 'yours (masc, informal)'. El tuyo = yours. Fem: tuya. Pl: tuyos/tuyas. ¿Es tuyo? = Is it yours? Lo tuyo = your thing/what's yours.

examples.es: ¿Es tuyo este abrigo o es de otra persona?
examples.en: Is this coat yours or does it belong to someone else?

notes: Multiple meanings: countryside, field (agricultural or sports), and field (academic/professional).

examples.es: Pasamos el fin de semana en el campo.
examples.en: We spent the weekend in the countryside.

notes: Feminine noun 'situation'. En esta situación = in this situation. Situación difícil = difficult situation. Situación económica = economic situation. Mejorar la situación = to improve the situation.

examples.es: La situación es más grave de lo que pensaba.
examples.en: The situation is more serious than I thought.

notes: Preposition 'after/behind/following'. Tras + noun/inf = after. Uno tras otro = one after another. More formal than después de. Día tras día = day after day.

examples.es: Tras la reunión, salimos a cenar.
examples.en: After the meeting, we went out for dinner.

notes: Masculine noun 'hotel'. En el hotel = at the hotel. Reservar un hotel = to book a hotel. Hotel de cinco estrellas = five-star hotel. Recepción del hotel = hotel reception.

examples.es: Reservamos un hotel cerca de la playa.
examples.en: We booked a hotel near the beach.

notes: Second-person plural subject pronoun (Spain only, informal). Not used in Latin America (ustedes instead). Verb endings: -áis/-éis/-ís. Os is its object pronoun.

examples.es: ¿Vosotros también venís a la fiesta?
examples.en: Are you all coming to the party too?

notes: Regular -ar verb. Used for machines, plans, relationships: ¿Funciona? = Does it work? No funciona = It's broken.

examples.es: El ascensor no funciona hoy.
examples.en: The lift isn't working today.

notes: Short for fotografía. Despite ending in -o, it is feminine.

examples.es: ¿Me sacas una foto?
examples.en: Can you take a photo of me?

notes: Masculine noun 'lawyer/attorney'. Mi abogado = my lawyer. Abogado defensor = defense lawyer. Abogado de oficio = court-appointed lawyer. Fem: abogada.

examples.es: Necesitas hablar con un abogado antes de firmar.
examples.en: You need to speak to a lawyer before signing.

notes: As adverb: around, surrounding. With de: alrededor de = around/approximately. A su alrededor = around him/her.

examples.es: Había gente alrededor del escenario.
examples.en: There were people around the stage.

notes: feminine singular of próximo; carries an acute accent on the o; used attributively and predicatively; often appears in time/place phrases (la próxima semana, la estación más próxima).

examples.es: La próxima semana viajaré a Madrid.
examples.en: Next week I will travel to Madrid.

examples.es: La parada más próxima está a dos minutos.
examples.en: The nearest stop is two minutes away.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to finish/end'. Terminar de + inf = to finish doing. Terminar con = to end/break up with. Terminarse = to run out. Al final, en definitiva.

examples.es: Termina los deberes antes de salir a jugar.
examples.en: Finish your homework before going out to play.

notes: Regular -ar (spelling c→gu before e) verb 'to pay'. Pagar en efectivo/con tarjeta. ¿Quién paga? = Who's paying? Pagar las consecuencias = to pay the consequences.

examples.es: ¿Pagamos con tarjeta o en efectivo?
examples.en: Do we pay by card or cash?

notes: Invariable by gender. Also noun: el personal = the staff/personnel.

examples.es: Es un asunto muy personal.
examples.en: It's a very personal matter.

notes: Regular -ir verb, usually impersonal: ocurre que = it happens that; ¿qué ocurre? = what's happening? Synonym: pasar, suceder.

examples.es: ¿Sabes lo que ocurrió anoche?
examples.en: Do you know what happened last night?

notes: Masculine noun 'memory/souvenir'. Un recuerdo = a memory/a souvenir. Guardar el recuerdo = to keep the memory. Recuerdos a tu familia = regards to your family. De recuerdo = as a keepsake.

examples.es: Guardo muy buenos recuerdos de ese viaje.
examples.en: I have very good memories of that trip.

notes: Feminine noun 'half/middle'. A mitad de = halfway through. La mitad = half. Por la mitad = in half. A mitad de precio = half price. En la mitad = in the middle.

examples.es: Comí la mitad del pastel yo solo.
examples.en: I ate half the cake by myself.

notes: Masculine noun 'hair'. Cortarse el pelo = to get a haircut. Por los pelos = by the skin of one's teeth. Tomar el pelo = to pull someone's leg. No tiene un pelo de tonto.

examples.es: Se cortó el pelo muy corto este verano.
examples.en: She cut her hair very short this summer.

notes: En compañía de = in the company of. Also business company (like empresa).

examples.es: Trabaja para una compañía internacional.
examples.en: She works for an international company.

notes: Feminine noun 'relationship/relation'. Tener una relación = to be in a relationship. En relación con = in relation to. Relaciones públicas = public relations. Pl: relaciones.

examples.es: Tienen una relación muy buena.
examples.en: They have a very good relationship.

notes: masculine noun; also used colloquially as an adverbial expression (hacer algo en montón → uncommon) and in expressions like 'un montón de' meaning 'a lot of'.

examples.es: Hay un montón de libros en la mesa.
examples.en: There are a lot of books on the table.

examples.es: Me ayudó un montón.
examples.en: They helped me a lot.

notes: Can be transitive (mejorar algo) or reflexive (mejorarse = to get better/recover).

examples.es: Las cosas van a mejorar.
examples.en: Things are going to improve.

examples.es: Ha mejorado mucho su español.
examples.en: Her Spanish has improved a lot.

notes: Feminine noun 'dinner/supper'. Cenar = to have dinner. ¿Qué hay de cena? = What's for dinner?

examples.es: La cena estará lista en media hora.
examples.en: Dinner will be ready in half an hour.

notes: Masculine noun 'accident'. Tener un accidente = to have an accident. Por accidente = by accident.

examples.es: Hubo un accidente en la autopista esta mañana.
examples.en: There was an accident on the motorway this morning.

notes: Third-person feminine plural subject pronoun 'they (fem)'. Usually omitted except for emphasis or contrast.
feminine noun; has several senses including container (box), financial/retail register (la caja), and figurative uses (caja fuerte). Common collocations: 'abrir la caja', 'en la caja'.

examples.es: Pon los libros en la caja.
examples.en: Put the books in the box.

examples.es: Paga en la caja, por favor.
examples.en: Pay at the register, please.

notes: used as interjection: tranquilo/a = relax, don't worry

examples.es: Mantén la calma, todo está tranquilo.
examples.en: Stay calm, everything is quiet.

examples.es: Es un barrio muy tranquilo.
examples.en: It is a very quiet neighborhood.

notes: Adjective 'pretty/nice/lovely'. More informal than hermoso. ¡Qué bonito! = How lovely!

examples.es: Qué vestido tan bonito llevas.
examples.en: What a pretty dress you are wearing.

examples.es: El jardín está muy bonito en primavera.
examples.en: The garden is very nice in spring.

notes: Estúpido/estúpida. Common insult. More informal than tonto.

examples.es: ¡No seas estúpido!
examples.en: Don't be stupid!

notes: Feminine noun 'line'. Línea recta = straight line. En línea = online. Línea de metro = metro line.

examples.es: La línea de metro más cercana está a dos calles.
examples.en: The nearest metro line is two streets away.

notes: ¡Caballeros! = Gentlemen! (sign on a door or address). Un verdadero caballero = a real gentleman. Caballero medieval = medieval knight. Andante caballero / caballero andante = knight errant (Don Quijote).

examples.es: El caballero cedió su asiento a la señora.
examples.en: The gentleman gave up his seat to the lady.

notes: Feminine noun 'shop/store/tent'. Tienda de ropa = clothing store. Ir de tiendas = to go shopping.

examples.es: La tienda cierra a las nueve de la noche.
examples.en: The shop closes at nine in the evening.

notes: Regular -ar verb 'to buy/purchase'. Ir de compras = to go shopping. Comprar en línea = to buy online.

examples.es: Voy a comprar el pan antes de volver a casa.
examples.en: I'm going to buy bread before going home.

notes: Masculine noun 'center/city center'. Centro comercial = shopping center. En el centro = downtown.

examples.es: El museo está en el centro de la ciudad.
examples.en: The museum is in the city centre.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Salvar la vida = to save someone's life. Salvarse = to survive/escape.

examples.es: El médico le salvó la vida.
examples.en: The doctor saved his life.

notes: Masculine noun 'sun'. Hace sol = it's sunny. Tomar el sol = to sunbathe. Ponerse el sol = sunset.

examples.es: Hace mucho sol hoy — ponte protector.
examples.en: It's very sunny today — put on sunscreen.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Colloquial and can be mild or harsh depending on tone. As noun: a fool/idiot.

examples.es: No seas tonto, claro que puedes.
examples.en: Don't be silly, of course you can.

notes: takes masculine article in singular: el hambre

examples.es: Tengo mucha hambre, ¿cuándo comemos?
examples.en: I'm very hungry — when do we eat?

notes: Feminine noun 'table'. Poner la mesa = to set the table. Mesa redonda = round table.

examples.es: Pon los platos en la mesa, por favor.
examples.en: Put the plates on the table, please.

notes: Feminine noun 'answer/response/reply'. En respuesta a = in response to. No hay respuesta = no reply.

examples.es: No tengo respuesta para esa pregunta.
examples.en: I don't have an answer to that question.

notes: Formed from completo + -mente.
Three main meanings: letter (mail), playing card, menu (in a restaurant). Carta de presentación = cover letter.

examples.es: El camarero nos trajo la carta.
examples.en: The waiter brought us the menu.

notes: Formed from total + -mente. Equivalent to completamente.
Adjective 'impossible'. Es imposible = it's impossible. Nada es imposible = nothing is impossible.

examples.es: Eso es absolutamente imposible.
examples.en: That is absolutely impossible.

examples.es: Parece imposible pero lo logramos.
examples.en: It seemed impossible but we managed it.

notes: Stem-changing o→ue. Three main uses: (1) to taste/try (food), (2) to test/try out, (3) to prove. Probarse = to try on (clothing).

examples.es: ¿Puedo probar ese postre?
examples.en: Can I try that dessert?

notes: also means groom at a wedding

examples.es: Su novio le regaló flores para su cumpleaños.
examples.en: Her boyfriend gave her flowers for her birthday.

notes: Adjective 'normal/ordinary/usual'. Es lo normal = it's normal. Por lo normal = normally.

examples.es: Es completamente normal sentirse así.
examples.en: It is completely normal to feel that way.

examples.es: Llevamos una vida bastante normal.
examples.en: We lead a fairly normal life.

notes: Highly irregular verb 'to bring'. Traigo, traes, trae, traemos, traéis, traen. Trae = bring (imperative).

examples.es: Trae el paraguas, parece que va a llover.
examples.en: Bring the umbrella, it looks like it's going to rain.

notes: Feminine noun 'direction/address/management'. ¿En qué dirección? = In which direction? Dirección postal = mailing address.

examples.es: ¿Me puedes dar la dirección del restaurante?
examples.en: Can you give me the address of the restaurant?

notes: Cardinal number 7.

examples.es: Hay siete días en la semana.
examples.en: There are seven days in the week.

notes: General word for any boat or ship. Barco de vela = sailing boat. Barco de vapor = steamship.

examples.es: El barco salió del puerto al amanecer.
examples.en: The ship left the port at dawn.

notes: Adjective/noun 'white/blank'. En blanco = blank. Vino blanco = white wine. Quedarse en blanco = to blank out.

examples.es: El techo es de color blanco.
examples.en: The ceiling is white.

examples.es: Firmó el cheque en blanco.
examples.en: He signed the blank check.

notes: Masculine noun 'teacher/professor'. Profesor universitario = university professor. Fem: profesora.

examples.es: El profesor explicó el tema con mucha claridad.
examples.en: The teacher explained the topic very clearly.

notes: Servicios = restrooms (Spain). Servicio militar = military service. Servicio de atención al cliente = customer service.

examples.es: El servicio en este restaurante es excelente.
examples.en: The service at this restaurant is excellent.

notes: Muchacho/muchacha. Informal, slightly old-fashioned in Spain but common in LatAm.

examples.es: Es un buen muchacho.
examples.en: He's a good boy.

notes: Feminine noun 'meeting/gathering'. Tener una reunión = to have a meeting. Reunión de emergencia = emergency meeting.

examples.es: La reunión empieza a las diez en punto.
examples.en: The meeting starts at ten o'clock sharp.

notes: Feminine noun 'law'. Cumplir la ley = to obey the law. Ley y orden = law and order. Aprobar una ley = to pass a law.

examples.es: Todos debemos respetar la ley.
examples.en: We all have to respect the law.

notes: Masculine despite -a ending. Covers TV show, computer program, schedule, and political programme.

examples.es: ¿Qué programa de televisión te gusta más?
examples.en: Which TV show do you like most?

examples.es: Estudia la carrera de ingeniería.
examples.en: He's studying engineering.

notes: plural unchanged: los cumpleaños

examples.es: Mañana es el cumpleaños de mi madre.
examples.en: Tomorrow is my mother's birthday.

notes: Feminine noun 'song'. Cantar una canción = to sing a song. Canción de cuna = lullaby.

examples.es: Esa canción me recuerda al verano.
examples.en: That song reminds me of summer.

notes: Hermoso/hermosa. More literary/formal than bonito or guapo.

examples.es: ¡Qué lugar tan hermoso!
examples.en: What a beautiful place!

notes: Feminine noun 'university'. Ir a la universidad = to go to university. Universidad pública = public university.

examples.es: Estudié Medicina en la universidad.
examples.en: I studied Medicine at university.

notes: Bodas de plata/oro = silver/golden wedding anniversary.

examples.es: Fuimos a la boda de mi prima.
examples.en: We went to my cousin's wedding.

examples.es: La boda fue en una playa preciosa.
examples.en: The wedding was on a beautiful beach.

notes: Sala de estar = living room. Sala de espera = waiting room. Sala de cine = cinema screen/theatre.

examples.es: Nos reunimos todos en la sala de estar.
examples.en: We all gathered in the living room.

notes: Tomar una decisión = to make a decision. La decisión final = the final decision.

examples.es: Tienes que tomar una decisión.
examples.en: You have to make a decision.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Es necesario + inf = it is necessary to. Lo necesario = what is necessary/enough.

examples.es: No es necesario que vengas si no quieres.
examples.en: It's not necessary for you to come if you don't want to.

notes: The common table salt. Sales (plural) = salts (chemistry, bath salts). Echar sal = to add salt.

examples.es: Pon un poco de sal a la pasta.
examples.en: Add a little salt to the pasta.

notes: Tener prisa = to be in a hurry. Darse prisa = to hurry up. De prisa = quickly.

examples.es: Tengo mucha prisa.
examples.en: I'm in a big hurry.

examples.es: ¡Date prisa!
examples.en: Hurry up!

notes: Adjective 'interesting'. Muy interesante = very interesting. Ponerse interesante = to get interesting.

examples.es: Fue una conversación muy interesante.
examples.en: It was a very interesting conversation.

examples.es: Tiene una perspectiva interesante sobre el tema.
examples.en: He has an interesting perspective on the subject.

notes: escuchar = to listen (active); oír = to hear (passive)

examples.es: Escucha bien antes de responder.
examples.en: Listen carefully before answering.

notes: Abuelos = grandparents (collective). Masculine: abuelo.

examples.es: Mi abuela cocina muy bien.
examples.en: My grandmother cooks very well.

notes: Gender-invariant: el/la detective. Private or police detective.

examples.es: El detective siguió al sospechoso.
examples.en: The detective followed the suspect.

examples.es: Contrataron a una detective privada.
examples.en: They hired a private detective.

notes: Invariable by gender; plural: horribles. Stronger than 'malo'. Also: horroroso.

examples.es: Fue una experiencia horrible.
examples.en: It was a horrible experience.

examples.es: Hace un tiempo horrible.
examples.en: The weather is horrible.

notes: Can mean the ground underfoot, the soil/earth, or a floor inside a building.

examples.es: El vaso cayó al suelo.
examples.en: The glass fell to the floor.

notes: Feminine noun 'prison/jail'. Estar en la cárcel = to be in prison. Entrar en la cárcel = to go to jail.

examples.es: Lo condenaron a cinco años de cárcel.
examples.en: He was sentenced to five years in prison.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Intentar + infinitive = to try to do something. Synonym: tratar de.

examples.es: Intenté llamarte pero no contestaste.
examples.en: I tried to call you but you didn't answer.

notes: Used as a noun ('a curse') and as an exclamation ('damn!'). ¡Maldición! = Damn! Echar una maldición = to put a curse on someone.

examples.es: ¡Maldición, se me olvidaron las llaves!
examples.en: Damn, I forgot the keys!

notes: Masculine noun 'silence'. Guardar silencio = to keep silent. ¡Silencio! = Quiet! En silencio = silently.

examples.es: Por favor, hagan silencio durante el examen.
examples.en: Please keep quiet during the exam.

notes: Adjective 'capable/able'. Ser capaz de = to be capable of/able to. Capaz que = maybe (L.Am. colloquial).

examples.es: Eres capaz de hacerlo solo.
examples.en: You are capable of doing it alone.

examples.es: No sé si seré capaz de terminar a tiempo.
examples.en: I don't know if I'll be able to finish in time.

notes: Anglicism used widely. Can refer to a sports club, nightclub, or social club. Plural: clubes or clubs.

examples.es: Es miembro del club de fútbol.
examples.en: He is a member of the football club.

notes: More formal/literary than 'tener miedo de'. Temer que + subjunctive = to fear that.

examples.es: Teme lo peor.
examples.en: He fears the worst.

examples.es: Temo que sea demasiado tarde.
examples.en: I fear it may be too late.

notes: En broma = jokingly; ¿Es una broma? = Are you kidding?

examples.es: Fue solo una broma, no te enfades.
examples.en: It was just a joke, don't get upset.

notes: Masculine noun 'government'. Gobierno central = central government. Jefe de gobierno = head of government.

examples.es: El gobierno anunció nuevas medidas económicas.
examples.en: The government announced new economic measures.

notes: Camera (photo/video). Also chamber (legislative body): Cámara de Diputados. Cámara de fotos = still camera; cámara de vídeo = video camera.

examples.es: Olvidé la cámara en el hotel.
examples.en: I forgot the camera at the hotel.

notes: As adjective: media hora = half an hour. As noun (la media): average, or (pl. los medios) the media. Medios de comunicación = media/communications.

examples.es: Espera media hora y llámame.
examples.en: Wait half an hour and call me.

notes: Invariable by gender. Plural: terribles.

examples.es: Fue un accidente terrible.
examples.en: It was a terrible accident.

notes: Masculine noun 'gift/present'. Hacer un regalo = to give a gift. Envolver un regalo = to wrap a present.

examples.es: Le hice un regalo por su cumpleaños.
examples.en: I gave her a gift for her birthday.

notes: Invariable by gender; plural: amables. Es usted muy amable = You are very kind (formal).

examples.es: Fue muy amable al ayudarme.
examples.en: He was very kind in helping me.

examples.es: La recepcionista era muy amable.
examples.en: The receptionist was very friendly.

notes: Invariable for gender (dulce for masc and fem). Agrees in number: dulces. Used for taste (sweet) and personality (gentle/sweet).

examples.es: Este postre está demasiado dulce para mi gusto.
examples.en: This dessert is too sweet for my taste.

notes: Ataque al corazón = heart attack. Ataque de nervios = nervous breakdown. Also used in sport: el equipo está en ataque = the team is attacking.

examples.es: El soldado sobrevivió el ataque.
examples.en: The soldier survived the attack.

notes: Usually capitalised. Feliz Navidad = Merry Christmas. Las Navidades (plural) = the Christmas season. Árbol de Navidad = Christmas tree.

examples.es: ¡Feliz Navidad a toda la familia!
examples.en: Merry Christmas to the whole family!

notes: Usually used in plural. Hombre/mujer de negocios = businessman/businesswoman. Hacer negocios = to do business. Singular: negocio = a deal/business venture.

examples.es: Viaja mucho por negocios.
examples.en: He travels a lot for business.

notes: Cardinal number 8.

examples.es: La tienda cierra a las ocho.
examples.en: The store closes at eight.

notes: Masculine noun 'airplane'. En avión = by plane. Perder el avión = to miss the plane. Billete de avión = plane ticket.

examples.es: El avión despegó a las doce.
examples.en: The plane took off at twelve.

notes: Investigación criminal = criminal investigation. Investigación científica = scientific research. Verb: investigar.

examples.es: La investigación duró tres años.
examples.en: The investigation lasted three years.

notes: Irregular, conjugated like tener. Mantenerse = to stay/remain.

examples.es: Hay que mantener la calma.
examples.en: One must maintain calm.

notes: Ejército de tierra = army (land forces). Ejército del aire = air force. From Latin exercitus. Note the accent on the é.

examples.es: Se unió al ejército a los dieciocho años.
examples.en: He joined the army at eighteen.

notes: Two meanings: physical paper and role/part (jugar un papel = to play a role).

examples.es: Juega un papel importante.
examples.en: He plays an important role.

notes: A partir de = from (a point in time/space): a partir de mañana = from tomorrow. Partir en dos = to split in two. Partir de = to set off from. Regular -ir verb.

examples.es: El tren parte a las nueve de la mañana.
examples.en: The train leaves at nine in the morning.

notes: Gracioso/graciosa. Also can mean cute in some contexts. Ser gracioso = to be funny.

examples.es: ¡Qué gracioso!
examples.en: How funny!

notes: Al principio = at the beginning. Principios morales = moral principles. Two distinct meanings.

examples.es: Al principio no entendía nada.
examples.en: At the beginning I didn't understand anything.

notes: Delante de = in front of (preposition phrase). Por delante = ahead. Contrasted with detrás (behind). Delante mío (informal) = in front of me.

examples.es: El coche de delante frenó de golpe.
examples.en: The car in front braked suddenly.

notes: Military rank below capitán. Teniente coronel = lieutenant colonel. Also used in police: teniente de policía. Common in crime/war films.

examples.es: El teniente dio las órdenes a su tropa.
examples.en: The lieutenant gave orders to his troops.

notes: From desear = to desire/wish. Pedir un deseo = to make a wish.

examples.es: Tengo un deseo que cumplir.
examples.en: I have a wish to fulfill.

notes: Nave espacial = spaceship. Nave industrial = industrial unit/warehouse. Also the nave of a church. More formal/literary than barco for 'ship'.

examples.es: La nave espacial despegó a las diez.
examples.en: The spacecraft launched at ten.

notes: Cubo de la basura = trash can. Sacar la basura = to take out the trash. Also used figuratively.

examples.es: Saca la basura, por favor.
examples.en: Take out the trash, please.

notes: Mantener contacto = to keep in touch. Ponerse en contacto con = to get in touch with.

examples.es: Mantengamos el contacto.
examples.en: Let's keep in touch.

notes: Esposo/esposa. Formal term for spouse. More formal than marido. Esposos = husband and wife.

examples.es: Mi esposo trabaja en el centro.
examples.en: My husband works downtown.

notes: Masculine noun 'train'. En tren = by train. Perder el tren = to miss the train. Estación de tren = train station.

examples.es: Tomamos el tren hasta Madrid.
examples.en: We took the train to Madrid.

notes: Verdadero/verdadera. Un verdadero amigo = a true friend. More emphatic than real/auténtico.

examples.es: Es un verdadero problema.
examples.en: It's a real problem.

notes: Feminine possessive pronoun 'yours'. La tuya = yours (fem). ¿Es tuya? = Is it yours? Lo tuyo = your thing.
Feminine noun that takes masculine article in singular (el alma) to avoid vowel clash.

examples.es: Lo siento en el alma.
examples.en: I feel it in my soul.

notes: As noun: una disculpa = an apology. Pedir disculpas = to apologise. As verb (disculpar): disculpa = forgive (tú imperative). Disculpe (usted) is the polite form.

examples.es: Te debo una disculpa por lo de ayer.
examples.en: I owe you an apology for yesterday.

notes: Junto a = next to, alongside. Juntos/juntas (adjectival) = together. Often used as preposition.
Irregular verb 'to walk/go'. Anduve (preterite). Andar bien/mal = to be going well/badly. ¡Anda! = Come on!/Wow!

examples.es: Anda unos diez kilómetros al día.
examples.en: She walks about ten kilometres a day.

notes: Both the institution of marriage and the married couple themselves.

examples.es: El matrimonio requiere compromiso.
examples.en: Marriage requires commitment.

examples.es: Son un matrimonio feliz.
examples.en: They're a happy married couple.

notes: Es una locura = it's madness/crazy. Volverse loco/a = to go crazy. Often used hyperbolically: ¡Qué locura! = How crazy! Related to loco (adj).

examples.es: Es una locura conducir con esta niebla.
examples.en: It's madness to drive in this fog.

notes: The metal gold or golden colour. 'De oro' = golden, made of gold. 'Vale su peso en oro' = worth its weight in gold.

examples.es: El anillo es de oro.
examples.en: The ring is made of gold.

examples.es: Ganó la medalla de oro.
examples.en: He won the gold medal.

notes: Con permiso = excuse me. Pedir permiso = to ask permission. Permiso de trabajo = work permit.

examples.es: ¿Me das permiso?
examples.en: Will you give me permission?

examples.es: Con permiso.
examples.en: Excuse me.

notes: Director/directora. Director de cine = film director. Director de escuela = school principal.

examples.es: El director de la película ganó un premio.
examples.en: The film director won an award.

examples.es: Estás en peligro.
examples.en: You are in danger.

examples.es: La libertad de expresión es un derecho fundamental.
examples.en: Freedom of expression is a fundamental right.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Bajar = to go down, lower, descend, download. Bajarse de = to get off (a vehicle). Bajar el volumen = to turn down the volume.

examples.es: Baja la voz, que están durmiendo.
examples.en: Lower your voice, they're sleeping.

notes: A chance or arranged meeting; also a sports match/fixture. 'Al encuentro de' = to meet.

examples.es: Fue un encuentro inesperado.
examples.en: It was an unexpected encounter.

examples.es: El encuentro entre los dos equipos fue emocionante.
examples.en: The match between the two teams was exciting.

notes: Maravilloso/maravillosa. A strong positive adjective. From maravilla = marvel/wonder.

examples.es: ¡Qué día tan maravilloso!
examples.en: What a wonderful day!

notes: El espacio exterior = outer space. Espacio en blanco = blank space. Espacio de tiempo = period of time. Needs el espacio (masc). Also: espacio personal = personal space.

examples.es: No hay espacio para otro mueble.
examples.en: There's no room for another piece of furniture.

notes: Un rato = a while. Al rato = a little while later. Hace un rato = a while ago.

examples.es: Espera un rato.
examples.en: Wait a while.

examples.es: Hace un rato que llegué.
examples.en: I arrived a while ago.

notes: Abuelos = grandparents (collective). Feminine: abuela.

examples.es: Mi abuelo tiene ochenta años.
examples.en: My grandfather is eighty years old.

notes: Said when someone sneezes. ¡Salud! used as toast. Estar de buena salud = to be in good health.

examples.es: ¡A tu salud!
examples.en: To your health! / Cheers!

notes: De sorpresa = by surprise. Fiesta sorpresa = surprise party. ¡Qué sorpresa! = What a surprise!

examples.es: Fue una gran sorpresa.
examples.en: It was a big surprise.

notes: Invariable for gender. Ponerse triste = to become sad. Qué triste = how sad.

examples.es: Se puso triste cuando escuchó la noticia.
examples.en: She became sad when she heard the news.

notes: Primary school teacher or master of a craft/art. La maestra = female teacher. Also used as a respectful address: ¡Maestro!

examples.es: El maestro explicó la lección con paciencia.
examples.en: The teacher explained the lesson patiently.

notes: Preposition/conjunction 'according to/depending on'. Según yo = in my opinion (L.Am.). Según y cómo = it depends.
Literal (religious hell) and figurative (ese trabajo es un infierno = that job is hell).

examples.es: Este tráfico es un infierno.
examples.en: This traffic is hell.

notes: Feminine of tío. In colloquial Spanish (Spain) also means 'woman/girl/mate'.

examples.es: Mi tía vive en Sevilla.
examples.en: My aunt lives in Seville.

examples.es: ¿Quién es esa tía?
examples.en: Who is that woman?

notes: A crime (usually serious — murder, etc.). Cf. delito (any criminal offence, including minor ones). Crimen organizado = organised crime.

examples.es: La policía investigó el crimen.
examples.en: The police investigated the crime.

notes: Un consejo = a piece of advice. Pedir consejo = to ask for advice. Consejo de administración = board of directors.

examples.es: Necesito tu consejo.
examples.en: I need your advice.

notes: Preposition 'before/in front of/faced with'. Ante todo = above all. Ante la ley = before the law.
Lowercase iglesia = any church building. Uppercase Iglesia = the institution (la Iglesia Católica).

examples.es: La boda fue en una iglesia pequeña.
examples.en: The wedding was in a small church.

notes: La mayoría de = most of. Mayoría de edad = legal adulthood/coming of age.

examples.es: La mayoría de los estudiantes aprobaron.
examples.en: The majority of the students passed.

notes: La escena del crimen = crime scene. Escena del acto I = scene from act I. Montar una escena = to make a scene. Salir a escena = to go on stage.

examples.es: Los policías acordonaron la escena del crimen.
examples.en: The police cordoned off the crime scene.

notes: Two key meanings: (1) apartment/flat (Spain), (2) floor/storey of a building. Latin America prefers apartamento or departamento for sense 1.

examples.es: Vivo en un piso en el centro de la ciudad.
examples.en: I live in a flat in the city centre.

notes: Signal, sign, or indicator. Dar señales de = to show signs of. Señal de tráfico = road sign.

examples.es: Espera mi señal.
examples.en: Wait for my signal.

examples.es: No hay señal de vida.
examples.en: There's no sign of life.

notes: Honour or integrity. En honor a la verdad = to tell the truth. Palabra de honor = word of honour. Honores militares = military honours.

examples.es: Lo hizo por honor, no por dinero.
examples.en: He did it for honour, not for money.

notes: Regular -ir verb but irregular past participle: abierto. Reflexive abrirse = to open up (emotionally or physically).

examples.es: Abre la puerta, por favor.
examples.en: Open the door, please.

notes: Brain (anatomy) or the brains/mastermind behind something.

examples.es: El cerebro humano es sorprendente.
examples.en: The human brain is remarkable.

examples.es: Es el cerebro del grupo.
examples.en: He's the brains of the group.

notes: Both the room (kitchen) and the activity (cooking/cuisine). Cocina española = Spanish cuisine.

examples.es: Preparó una cena increíble en la cocina.
examples.en: She prepared an incredible dinner in the kitchen.

notes: As noun: dress (clothing). As adjective (vestido/a): dressed. Vestido de noche = evening dress.

examples.es: Llevaba un vestido rojo en la fiesta.
examples.en: She was wearing a red dress at the party.

notes: Invariable for gender (inteligente for both masc and fem). Agrees in number: inteligentes. Ser inteligente = to be intelligent (permanent trait).

examples.es: Es la persona más inteligente que conozco.
examples.en: She's the most intelligent person I know.

notes: Horse. A caballo = on horseback. Caballo de batalla = pet subject/hobby horse. Also the knight piece in chess.

examples.es: Montó a caballo por primera vez.
examples.en: She rode a horse for the first time.

notes: In Spain a bar serves coffee, drinks and snacks at any time of day — not just alcohol. Ir de bares = to go bar-hopping. Also: bar (unit of pressure).

examples.es: Quedamos en el bar de la esquina.
examples.en: We're meeting at the bar on the corner.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Cortarse = to cut oneself, or to be cut off (phone call). Cortar con alguien = to break up with someone.

examples.es: Corta el pan en rodajas.
examples.en: Cut the bread into slices.

notes: ¡Adentro! = Come in! / Get inside! Tierra adentro = inland. Mar adentro = out to sea. Distinguished from dentro de (inside of, followed by noun).

examples.es: ¡Todos adentro, está lloviendo!
examples.en: Everyone inside, it's raining!

notes: Primarily means illegal drug in everyday speech. Medicamento or fármaco are used for medicine. Tráfico de drogas = drug trafficking. Drogarse = to take drugs.

examples.es: La policía incautó una gran cantidad de droga.
examples.en: The police seized a large quantity of drugs.

notes: Invariable by gender. Plural: agradables. Una persona muy agradable = a very pleasant person.

examples.es: Pasamos una tarde muy agradable.
examples.en: We had a very pleasant afternoon.

notes: Carne de res = beef. Carne de cerdo = pork. Carne de pollo = chicken. Also the word for flesh (physical tissue).

examples.es: No como carne, soy vegetariano.
examples.en: I don't eat meat, I'm vegetarian.

notes: In Spain: department (of a company, university). In Latin America: also means apartment (= piso in Spain). Departamento de policía = police department.

examples.es: Trabaja en el departamento de ventas.
examples.en: She works in the sales department.

notes: Lindo/linda. More common in LatAm than Spain. ¡Qué lindo! = How cute/lovely!

examples.es: ¡Qué lindo bebé!
examples.en: What a cute baby!

notes: Usually masculine (el mar) in standard usage, but feminine (la mar) in poetry and some regional/fixed expressions (a la mar = out to sea).

examples.es: Pasamos las vacaciones junto al mar.
examples.en: We spent the holidays by the sea.

notes: A doubt or question. Sin duda = without doubt/certainly. Tener dudas = to have doubts. Poner en duda = to call into question.

examples.es: Si tienes alguna duda, pregúntame.
examples.en: If you have any questions, ask me.

notes: Edificio de oficinas = office building. Edificio de apartamentos = apartment block. From Latin aedificium. Note: not used for small private houses (use casa).

examples.es: El edificio tiene veinte pisos.
examples.en: The building has twenty floors.

notes: Estar a cargo de = to be in charge of. Cargo público = public office. Hacerse cargo = to take charge. Also: cargo (freight). No confundir con inglés 'charge' (cobrar).

examples.es: Está a cargo del departamento desde enero.
examples.en: She has been in charge of the department since January.

notes: Gender-invariant in common use: la víctima (even for male). Victim of crime, accident, or disaster.

examples.es: La víctima fue identificada.
examples.en: The victim was identified.

examples.es: Hubo muchas víctimas en el accidente.
examples.en: There were many casualties in the accident.

notes: Lowercase luna = the moon or any moon. Uppercase Luna = Earth's moon (proper noun). Luna de miel = honeymoon.

examples.es: Esta noche hay luna llena.
examples.en: There's a full moon tonight.

notes: Physical energy, electrical energy, or personal vitality. Energías renovables = renewable energy.

examples.es: Necesitamos más energías renovables.
examples.en: We need more renewable energy.

examples.es: Hoy no tengo energía.
examples.en: I have no energy today.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: frío/fría/fríos/frías. Tener frío = to feel cold (person). Hacer frío = to be cold (weather). Estar frío = to be cold (object).

examples.es: El agua está muy fría hoy.
examples.en: The water is very cold today.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Bailar salsa/tango/flamenco = to dance salsa/tango/flamenco. Sacar a bailar a alguien = to ask someone to dance.

examples.es: ¿Quieres bailar conmigo?
examples.en: Do you want to dance with me?

notes: Military, religious, or figurative mission. Also space/scientific mission.

examples.es: La misión fue un éxito.
examples.en: The mission was a success.

examples.es: Tenemos una misión importante.
examples.en: We have an important mission.

notes: A la izquierda = to the left. Gira a la izquierda = turn left. Also political left: la izquierda = the left wing. Adjective form: izquierdo/a = left-hand.

examples.es: El banco está a la izquierda de la farmacia.
examples.en: The bank is to the left of the pharmacy.

notes: Regular -er verb. Used for drinking any liquid. Cf. tomar, which is broader (to have food or drink).

examples.es: ¿Qué quieres beber?
examples.en: What do you want to drink?

notes: Formed from final + -mente. Synonym: por fin (more colloquial).
Invariable by gender. Can be slightly pejorative: un simple malentendido = a mere misunderstanding.

examples.es: Es muy simple de entender.
examples.en: It's very simple to understand.

notes: Regular -ar verb. More common in LatAm; Spain prefers volver.

examples.es: Regresé tarde a casa.
examples.en: I returned home late.
