notes: Bala perdida = stray bullet/wild child (colloquial). Como una bala = like a shot (very fast).

examples.es: La bala pasó muy cerca.
examples.en: The bullet passed very close.

notes: A period of time, era, or season. En aquella época = at that time/in those days. Cada época tiene sus modas.

examples.es: Fue la mejor época de su vida.
examples.en: It was the best period of his life.

notes: Puente colgante = suspension bridge. Hacer puente = to take a long weekend (Spain).

examples.es: Cruzamos el puente sobre el río.
examples.en: We crossed the bridge over the river.

notes: A qué distancia = how far away. Mantener la distancia = to keep one's distance. A distancia = remotely/from afar.

examples.es: ¿A qué distancia está el aeropuerto?
examples.en: How far is the airport?

notes: Leg (body part from hip to foot). Cf. pie (foot) and rodilla (knee). Estirar las piernas = to stretch one's legs.

examples.es: Se rompió la pierna en el accidente.
examples.en: She broke her leg in the accident.

notes: Very versatile verb. Echar de menos = to miss (someone). Echar una mano = to lend a hand. Echar a perder = to ruin.

examples.es: Te echo de menos.
examples.en: I miss you.

examples.es: Echa sal a la comida.
examples.en: Add salt to the food.

notes: Note: feminine noun but takes el/un before it (el área, un área) due to stressed initial a-.

examples.es: Trabaja en el área de marketing.
examples.en: She works in the marketing area.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Estar orgulloso de = to be proud of. Can carry a negative connotation of arrogance in some contexts.

examples.es: Estoy muy orgullosa de mis hijos.
examples.en: I'm very proud of my children.

notes: Es magia = it's magic. Magia negra = black magic. Por arte de magia = as if by magic.

examples.es: Cree en la magia.
examples.en: She believes in magic.

notes: Invariable for gender (nacional). Agrees in number: nacionales. Carretera nacional = A-road/national road.

examples.es: El equipo nacional ganó la copa.
examples.en: The national team won the cup.

notes: El universo = the universe. Universo paralelo = parallel universe. In extended meaning: world/sphere.

examples.es: El universo es infinito.
examples.en: The universe is infinite.

notes: Note irregular plural: nariz → narices. Sonarse la nariz = to blow one's nose. Meter las narices = to stick one's nose in.

examples.es: Me pica la nariz.
examples.en: My nose is itchy.

notes: Shame or embarrassment. Tener vergüenza = to feel ashamed/embarrassed. ¡Qué vergüenza! = How embarrassing! / Shame on you! Sin vergüenza = shameless.

examples.es: Me da vergüenza hablar en público.
examples.en: I feel embarrassed speaking in public.

notes: Monstruo marino = sea monster. Coloquially: un monstruo del fútbol = a football genius/beast.

examples.es: El niño tiene miedo de los monstruos.
examples.en: The child is afraid of monsters.

notes: Feminine of príncipe. Cuento de princesas = fairy tale with princesses.

examples.es: Se vistió de princesa para la fiesta.
examples.en: She dressed up as a princess for the party.

notes: Standard word for bus (city or intercity). Shortened to bus in informal use. In Latin America often replaced by camión, colectivo, micro, or ómnibus depending on region.

examples.es: Tomamos el autobús hasta el centro.
examples.en: We took the bus to the city centre.

notes: Dar un paseo = to go for a walk. Paseo marítimo = seafront promenade. Paseo en bicicleta = bike ride.

examples.es: Vamos a dar un paseo.
examples.en: Let's go for a walk.

notes: Verb in -ducir: yo conduzco, strong preterite conduje. Conducir un coche = to drive a car.

examples.es: Conduce con cuidado, hay niebla.
examples.en: Drive carefully, there's fog.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Aceptar una oferta = to accept an offer. Aceptar que = to accept/acknowledge that.

examples.es: Aceptaron las condiciones del contrato.
examples.en: They accepted the terms of the contract.

notes: Also used informally to mean a brute or rough person.

examples.es: Los niños aprenden los nombres de los animales.
examples.en: Children learn the names of animals.

notes: Society (social group) or company (business — Sociedad Anónima = S.A. / plc). Alta sociedad = high society.

examples.es: Vivimos en una sociedad cada vez más conectada.
examples.en: We live in an increasingly connected society.

notes: Regular -er verb with spelling change g→j before a/o (protejo, proteja). Protegerse de = to protect oneself from.

examples.es: Su misión es proteger a los ciudadanos.
examples.en: His mission is to protect the citizens.

notes: Regular -ir verb. Recibir a alguien = to receive/welcome someone. Recibir noticias = to get news.

examples.es: Recibí tu mensaje esta mañana.
examples.en: I received your message this morning.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Robar algo a alguien = to steal something from someone. Also used colloquially for overcharging (¡Me están robando! = They're robbing me!).

examples.es: Le robaron la cartera en el metro.
examples.en: His wallet was stolen on the metro.

notes: Al oeste de = west of. El salvaje oeste = the wild west.

examples.es: El sol se pone por el oeste.
examples.en: The sun sets in the west.

notes: A wound or injury. Herida abierta = open wound. Also figurative: herida emocional = emotional wound. Herir = to wound.

examples.es: La herida tardó semanas en cicatrizar.
examples.en: The wound took weeks to heal.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: oscuro/oscura/oscuros/oscuras. A oscuras = in the dark. Colores oscuros = dark colours.

examples.es: La habitación estaba completamente oscura.
examples.en: The room was completely dark.

notes: Market (place to buy/sell) or market (economic). Mercado de valores = stock market. Mercado negro = black market.

examples.es: Compra las verduras en el mercado local.
examples.en: Buy the vegetables at the local market.

notes: Agrees in gender (invariable: grave for masc and fem). Agrees in number: graves. Estar grave = to be seriously ill. Un error grave = a serious mistake.

examples.es: El paciente está en estado grave.
examples.en: The patient is in a critical condition.

notes: Weight (physical) or peso (currency of several Latin American countries). Perder/ganar peso = to lose/gain weight.

examples.es: Quiero perder algo de peso antes del verano.
examples.en: I want to lose some weight before summer.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Sector privado = private sector. Vida privada = private life. En privado = in private.

examples.es: Es una conversación privada.
examples.en: It's a private conversation.

notes: A look, gaze, or glance. Echar una mirada = to take a look. Una mirada perdida = a vacant stare.

examples.es: Me lanzó una mirada de sorpresa.
examples.en: She gave me a surprised look.

notes: Regular -er verb but irregular past participle: roto. Romperse = to break/snap (reflexive). Romper con alguien = to break up with someone.

examples.es: Se me rompió el teléfono.
examples.en: My phone broke.

notes: A garden (cultivated outdoor space). Jardín de infancia/infantil = kindergarten.

examples.es: Las flores del jardín huelen muy bien.
examples.en: The flowers in the garden smell lovely.

notes: Invariable for gender (natural). Agrees in number: naturales. Es natural que = it's natural that. Recursos naturales = natural resources.

examples.es: Prefiero los productos naturales a los artificiales.
examples.en: I prefer natural products to artificial ones.

notes: Chicken (the bird or the meat). Pollo asado = roast chicken. Pechuga de pollo = chicken breast.

examples.es: Vamos a cenar pollo asado esta noche.
examples.en: We're having roast chicken for dinner tonight.

notes: Effect or result. En efecto = indeed/in fact. Efectos especiales = special effects. Tener efecto = to take effect.

examples.es: El medicamento tuvo un efecto inmediato.
examples.en: The medicine had an immediate effect.

notes: Result or outcome. Como resultado = as a result. Dar resultado = to work/yield results.

examples.es: Los resultados del examen saldrán mañana.
examples.en: The exam results will come out tomorrow.

notes: Any hat with a brim. Sombrero de copa = top hat. Quitarse el sombrero = to take one's hat off (lit. and fig.).

examples.es: Llevaba un sombrero de paja en la playa.
examples.en: She was wearing a straw hat on the beach.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: limpio/limpia/limpios/limpias. Opposite: sucio. Estar limpio = to be clean. Tener las manos limpias = to have clean hands (be innocent).

examples.es: Deja el baño limpio después de usarlo.
examples.en: Leave the bathroom clean after using it.

notes: Stem e→i + g→j in yo (elijo). Elegir entre = to choose between. Ya está elegido = already chosen.

examples.es: Puedes elegir entre dos opciones.
examples.en: You can choose between two options.

notes: Will, willpower, or wish. Buena voluntad = goodwill. Fuerza de voluntad = willpower. A voluntad = at will.

examples.es: Tiene una fuerza de voluntad increíble.
examples.en: She has incredible willpower.

notes: Short story or tale. Cuento de hadas = fairy tale. No me vengas con cuentos = don't give me excuses/tall tales.

examples.es: Le leía un cuento antes de dormir.
examples.en: He read her a story before bed.

notes: Regular -ar verb. ¡Descansa! = Rest! / Good night! (informal).

examples.es: Necesito descansar un poco.
examples.en: I need to rest a bit.

notes: Regular -ar verb with accent shift on stressed í: envío, envías, envía, enviáis (no accent), envían.

examples.es: Te enviaré el documento por correo.
examples.en: I'll send you the document by email.

notes: Process (sequence of steps) or legal proceedings (proceso judicial = legal proceedings/trial).

examples.es: Es un proceso largo pero vale la pena.
examples.en: It's a long process but it's worth it.

notes: A road or highway (between towns). Cf. calle (urban street) and autopista (motorway). Carretera nacional = A-road.

examples.es: Hay mucho tráfico en la carretera esta mañana.
examples.en: There's a lot of traffic on the road this morning.

notes: Invariable for gender (débil). Agrees in number: débiles. Punto débil = weak point.

examples.es: Se sentía débil después de la enfermedad.
examples.en: She felt weak after the illness.

notes: Chest (body part). Dar el pecho = to breastfeed. A pecho descubierto = bare-chested; also: openly/with nothing to hide.

examples.es: Le dolía el pecho después de correr.
examples.en: His chest hurt after running.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Limpiar la casa = to clean the house. Also figurative: limpiar la imagen = to clean up one's image.

examples.es: Voy a limpiar la cocina después de cenar.
examples.en: I'm going to clean the kitchen after dinner.

notes: Regular -ar verb. In Latin America the standard word for driving a car (Spain uses conducir). Also: to handle/manage (una situación difícil).

examples.es: ¿Sabes manejar un camión?
examples.en: Do you know how to drive a truck?

notes: Invariable for gender (inútil). Agrees in number: inútiles. Also used as a noun: un inútil = a useless person.

examples.es: Este aparato es completamente inútil.
examples.en: This device is completely useless.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Before a noun: former (mi antiguo jefe = my former boss). After a noun: old/ancient (un edificio antiguo = an old building).

examples.es: Vive en un antiguo edificio del siglo XIX.
examples.en: He lives in an old 19th-century building.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Past participle of asustar used as adjective. Estar asustado/a = to be scared. Asustar = to frighten.

examples.es: El niño estaba asustado por la tormenta.
examples.en: The child was scared by the storm.

notes: Note plural: exámenes (accent drops). Hacer/presentar un examen = to sit an exam. Suspender/aprobar un examen = to fail/pass an exam.

examples.es: Tengo un examen muy importante mañana.
examples.en: I have a very important exam tomorrow.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Disparar un arma = to fire a weapon. Disparar una foto = to take a shot (photography). Dispararse = to skyrocket (prices).

examples.es: Se oyó un disparo en la noche.
examples.en: A shot was heard in the night.

examples.es: ¿Quieres más queso en la pizza?
examples.en: Do you want more cheese on the pizza?

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Also: big/serious (un problema gordo = a big problem). El gordo = the big lottery prize (Spain).

examples.es: El problema gordo es que no tenemos dinero.
examples.en: The big problem is that we have no money.

notes: Size or magnitude. ¿De qué tamaño? = What size? Tamaño natural = life-size.

examples.es: ¿Tienes esta camiseta en otro tamaño?
examples.en: Do you have this T-shirt in another size?

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Literal: deep (water, hole). Figurative: profound (thought, feeling). Respiración profunda = deep breathing.

examples.es: El lago es muy profundo en este punto.
examples.en: The lake is very deep at this point.

examples.es: El vuelo sale del aeropuerto a las ocho.
examples.en: The flight leaves from the airport at eight.

notes: Revenge or vengeance. Tomar venganza = to take revenge. Por venganza = out of revenge.

examples.es: Actuó movido por la venganza.
examples.en: He was driven by revenge.

notes: A shirt (with collar and buttons). Camisa de fuerza = straitjacket. En mangas de camisa = in shirtsleeves.

examples.es: Lleva una camisa azul y una corbata.
examples.en: He's wearing a blue shirt and a tie.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: sucio/sucia/sucios/sucias. Opposite: limpio. Juego sucio = foul play.

examples.es: Tienes las manos sucias, ve a lavártelas.
examples.en: Your hands are dirty, go and wash them.

examples.es: Fuimos a nadar al lago.
examples.en: We went to swim in the lake.

notes: Both the artwork (a painting) and the substance (paint). Pintura al óleo = oil painting. Pintura de paredes = wall paint.

examples.es: Tiene una colección de pinturas muy valiosas.
examples.en: He has a very valuable collection of paintings.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Short in length or duration (not height — for height use bajo). A corto plazo = short-term. Quedarse corto = to underestimate.

examples.es: La película es bastante corta, solo dura una hora.
examples.en: The film is quite short, it only lasts an hour.

notes: Irregular -ir verb with y insertion: destruyo, destruyes, destruye, destruimos, destruís, destruyen. Subjunctive: destruya…

examples.es: El fuego destruyó el edificio por completo.
examples.en: The fire completely destroyed the building.

notes: Agrees in gender/number: vacío/vacía/vacíos/vacías. Note the accent. Also used as a noun: el vacío = the void/emptiness.

examples.es: El frigorífico está casi vacío.
examples.en: The fridge is almost empty.

notes: Gender-common: el/la estudiante. Covers school pupils and university students.

examples.es: Los estudiantes presentaron sus proyectos.
examples.en: The students presented their projects.

notes: Verb in -uir: construyo, construyes... Construir una casa = to build a house.

examples.es: Están construyendo un nuevo hospital en las afueras.
examples.en: They are building a new hospital on the outskirts.

notes: Plate/dish (the object). Also a dish/course of a meal: primer plato = starter, plato principal = main course. Lavar los platos = to do the dishes.

examples.es: El plato principal fue un filete a la plancha.
examples.en: The main course was a grilled steak.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Ser famoso/a = to be famous. Hacerse famoso = to become famous.

examples.es: Es un cantante muy famoso en todo el mundo.
examples.en: He's a very famous singer all over the world.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Imaginarse = to imagine/picture (reflexive). ¡Imagínate! = Just imagine! / Can you believe it!

examples.es: Imagina que puedes volar.
examples.en: Imagine you can fly.

notes: Invariable for gender (social). Agrees in number: sociales. Redes sociales = social media/networks.

examples.es: Las redes sociales han cambiado la forma de comunicarnos.
examples.en: Social media has changed the way we communicate.

notes: Community or autonomous region (Comunidad Autónoma = autonomous community, the main administrative division of Spain).

examples.es: Es importante ayudar a la comunidad local.
examples.en: It's important to help the local community.

notes: The stomach (organ or the belly area). Dolor de estómago = stomachache. Tener buen estómago = to have a strong stomach.

examples.es: Me duele el estómago después de comer.
examples.en: My stomach hurts after eating.

notes: Joy, happiness, or delight. ¡Qué alegría! = How wonderful! / What great news! Dar alegría = to bring joy.

examples.es: La noticia les llenó de alegría.
examples.en: The news filled them with joy.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Controlarse = to control oneself/keep calm. Fuera de control = out of control.

examples.es: Es difícil controlar tus emociones en esa situación.
examples.en: It's difficult to control your emotions in that situation.

notes: Used instead of "o" before words beginning with o or ho
Agrees in gender/number. Two uses: estar aburrido/a = to be bored (person); ser aburrido/a = to be boring (thing/person). Aburrir = to bore.

examples.es: Me aburro mucho en las reuniones largas.
examples.en: I get really bored in long meetings.

notes: Invariable for gender (útil). Agrees in number: útiles. Días útiles = working days. Lo útil = the useful thing.

examples.es: Este diccionario me resulta muy útil.
examples.en: I find this dictionary very useful.

notes: Verb in -uir: huyo, huyes, huye... Huir de = to flee from. Salir huyendo = to run away.

examples.es: El ladrón huyó antes de que llegara la policía.
examples.en: The thief fled before the police arrived.

notes: A promise. Cumplir una promesa = to keep a promise. Romper una promesa = to break a promise.

examples.es: Cumplió su promesa y volvió.
examples.en: He kept his promise and came back.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. More common in Latin America; Spain prefers enfadado. Estar enojado/a con alguien = to be angry with someone.

examples.es: Está muy enojado con su hermano.
examples.en: He's very angry with his brother.

notes: Cup or mug. Una taza de café = a cup of coffee. Distinct from vaso (a glass/tumbler without a handle).

examples.es: ¿Me preparas una taza de té?
examples.en: Can you make me a cup of tea?

notes: A jacket (lighter than an abrigo/coat). Chaqueta de punto = cardigan.

examples.es: Coge una chaqueta, que hace frío fuera.
examples.en: Grab a jacket, it's cold outside.

notes: Obvio/obvia. Es obvio que... = It's obvious that... Synonym: evidente.

examples.es: Es obvio que tiene razón.
examples.en: It's obvious that she's right.

notes: Overcoat or coat. Al abrigo de = sheltered from / under the protection of.

examples.es: Necesitas un buen abrigo para el invierno.
examples.en: You need a good coat for winter.

notes: A smile. Esbozar una sonrisa = to manage a smile. Sonrisa de oreja a oreja = ear-to-ear grin.

examples.es: Su sonrisa ilumina la habitación.
examples.en: Her smile lights up the room.

notes: A miracle. ¡Es un milagro! = It's a miracle! De milagro = miraculously/by a miracle.

examples.es: Sobrevivió de milagro al accidente.
examples.en: He survived the accident by a miracle.

notes: A private office or study. Distinct from oficina (open-plan office). Also: dispatch/sending of goods.

examples.es: El director está en su despacho.
examples.en: The director is in his office.

notes: A drinking glass (tumbler, no handle). Distinct from copa (stemmed glass for wine) and taza (cup with handle).

examples.es: ¿Me das un vaso de agua, por favor?
examples.en: Can you give me a glass of water, please?

notes: A rule, regulation, or ruler (measuring tool). En regla = in order/according to the rules. Por regla general = as a general rule.

examples.es: Las reglas del juego son muy sencillas.
examples.en: The rules of the game are very simple.

notes: Regular -ir verb. Decidir + inf = to decide to do something. Decidirse a = to make up one's mind to.

examples.es: ¿Ya has decidido qué vas a estudiar?
examples.en: Have you already decided what you're going to study?

examples.es: Llamaron a una ambulancia de inmediato.
examples.en: They called an ambulance immediately.

notes: Invariable for gender (suave). Agrees in number: suaves. Smooth to the touch, gentle in manner, mild in flavour.

examples.es: La seda es una tela muy suave.
examples.en: Silk is a very smooth fabric.

notes: Conscience (moral sense) or consciousness/awareness. Tener mala conciencia = to have a guilty conscience. Tomar conciencia de = to become aware of.

examples.es: No puede dormir por la mala conciencia.
examples.en: He can't sleep because of his guilty conscience.

notes: A nightmare. Tener una pesadilla = to have a nightmare. Also used figuratively: fue una pesadilla = it was a nightmare.

examples.es: Tuve una pesadilla horrible anoche.
examples.en: I had a horrible nightmare last night.

examples.es: Preparó una sopa de verduras muy rica.
examples.en: She made a very tasty vegetable soup.

notes: Desert (geographical). Also used as adjective: desierto/a = deserted/empty (a desierto street). Predicar en el desierto = to preach to deaf ears.

examples.es: El Sahara es el desierto más grande del mundo.
examples.en: The Sahara is the largest desert in the world.

notes: Stem-changing e→ie in stressed syllables. Also e→i in gerund (mintiendo) and 3rd-person preterite (mintió, mintieron) — but we omit preterite here.

examples.es: No me gusta que me mientan.
examples.en: I don't like people lying to me.

notes: Stem e→i throughout. Sirvo, sirves... Servir de = to serve as. ¿En qué le sirvo? = How can I help you?

examples.es: ¿En qué puedo servirle?
examples.en: How can I help you?

notes: Pride (the feeling). Sentir orgullo de = to feel proud of. A distinction from el orgulloso (the proud person).

examples.es: Siente un gran orgullo por sus logros.
examples.en: He feels great pride in his achievements.

examples.es: La catedral data del siglo XIV.
examples.en: The cathedral dates from the 14th century.

notes: Nation or country. Naciones Unidas = United Nations. Nacional (adj) = national.

examples.es: Representó a su nación en los Juegos Olímpicos.
examples.en: He represented his nation at the Olympic Games.

notes: Port or harbour. Also: mountain pass (puerto de montaña). Puerto USB/HDMI = USB/HDMI port (technology).

examples.es: El barco llegó al puerto al amanecer.
examples.en: The ship arrived at the port at dawn.

notes: Title (of a book, person, or rank), academic degree, or certificate. Título universitario = university degree.

examples.es: Obtuvo el título de ingeniero el año pasado.
examples.en: He obtained his engineering degree last year.

notes: Invariable for gender (urgente). Agrees in number: urgentes. Correo urgente = express mail. Con carácter urgente = as a matter of urgency.

examples.es: Necesito hablar contigo, es urgente.
examples.en: I need to talk to you, it's urgent.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Also used as a noun: el extranjero = a foreigner; en el extranjero = abroad.

examples.es: Vivió en el extranjero durante cinco años.
examples.en: She lived abroad for five years.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. A paso lento = at a slow pace. Lentamente = slowly. Cocción lenta = slow cooking.

examples.es: El tráfico estaba muy lento esta mañana.
examples.en: The traffic was very slow this morning.

examples.es: Es una serie de televisión muy popular.
examples.en: It's a very popular TV series.

notes: Fever or high temperature. Tener fiebre = to have a fever. Fiebre del oro = gold rush.

examples.es: El niño tiene mucha fiebre, hay que llamar al médico.
examples.en: The child has a high fever, we need to call the doctor.

notes: A feeling or emotion. Herir los sentimientos de alguien = to hurt someone's feelings.

examples.es: No sé cómo expresar mis sentimientos.
examples.en: I don't know how to express my feelings.

notes: Flower. En flor = in bloom. La flor y la nata = the cream of the crop. Flores silvestres = wildflowers.

examples.es: Le regaló un ramo de flores.
examples.en: He gave her a bunch of flowers.

notes: A criminal offence or crime (any severity). Cf. crimen (serious crime). Delito leve = minor offence. Cometer un delito = to commit an offence.

examples.es: Conducir borracho es un delito grave.
examples.en: Drink-driving is a serious offence.

notes: Regular -ar with c→qu before e. Both physical and figurative attacks.

examples.es: El equipo atacó desde el principio.
examples.en: The team attacked from the start.

notes: Egg. Huevo frito/revuelto/duro = fried/scrambled/hard-boiled egg. Note: in some Latin American countries huevos is a vulgar term, so care is advised.

examples.es: ¿Cómo quieres los huevos, fritos o revueltos?
examples.en: How do you want your eggs, fried or scrambled?

notes: A thought or idea. También: pansy (the flower). El libre pensamiento = free thinking.

examples.es: No puedo quitarme ese pensamiento de la cabeza.
examples.en: I can't get that thought out of my head.

notes: Short for motocicleta. Ir en moto = to ride a motorbike. Moto de agua = jet ski.

examples.es: Va al trabajo en moto todos los días.
examples.en: He goes to work by motorbike every day.

notes: En detalle = in detail. Al detalle = retail (comercio al detalle). ¡Qué detalle! = What a thoughtful gesture!

examples.es: Cuéntame todos los detalles.
examples.en: Tell me all the details.

notes: Culture (of a society, arts, or biology). Cultura general = general knowledge. Choque cultural = culture shock.

examples.es: Es un país con una cultura muy rica.
examples.en: It's a country with a very rich culture.

notes: Shoulder (body part). Encogerse de hombros = to shrug. Llevar a hombros = to carry on one's shoulders.

examples.es: Me duelen los hombros de estar sentado.
examples.en: My shoulders hurt from sitting down.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Also used as a noun: un desconocido/una desconocida = a stranger. Lo desconocido = the unknown.

examples.es: Me llamó un número desconocido.
examples.en: An unknown number called me.

examples.es: La temporada de verano empieza en junio.
examples.en: The summer season starts in June.

notes: Loyalty or fidelity. Con lealtad = loyally. Lealtad a la marca = brand loyalty.

examples.es: La lealtad es una de las virtudes más importantes.
examples.en: Loyalty is one of the most important virtues.

notes: Custom, habit, or tradition. Tener la costumbre de = to be in the habit of. Como de costumbre = as usual.

examples.es: Tiene la costumbre de levantarse muy temprano.
examples.en: She has the habit of getting up very early.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Also used as a noun: el científico/la científica = the scientist.

examples.es: Los avances científicos cambian nuestra vida.
examples.en: Scientific advances change our lives.

notes: Irregular: stem e→í throughout. Yo me río. Reír de = to laugh at. No dejes de reír = keep laughing.

examples.es: Nos reímos mucho con esa película.
examples.en: We laughed a lot at that film.

notes: Invariable for gender (internacional). Agrees in number: internacionales.

examples.es: Es un problema de carácter internacional.
examples.en: It is a problem of an international nature.

notes: Emotion or excitement. ¡Qué emoción! = How exciting! Emocional = emotional.

examples.es: La película estuvo llena de emociones.
examples.en: The film was full of emotions.

examples.es: Respeto todas las religiones del mundo.
examples.en: I respect all religions in the world.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. Also used as a noun: el político/la política = a politician. La política = politics or policy.

examples.es: Hay que resolver esto por medios políticos.
examples.en: This must be resolved by political means.

notes: Betrayal or treason. Alta traición = high treason. A traición = treacherously/from behind.

examples.es: Lo que hizo fue una traición imperdonable.
examples.en: What he did was an unforgivable betrayal.

notes: Orange (the fruit). As an adjective (colour): invariable — una camiseta naranja. Zumo/jugo de naranja = orange juice.

examples.es: Tomé un zumo de naranja en el desayuno.
examples.en: I had an orange juice at breakfast.

notes: Regular -ar with z→c before e. To throw, launch, or release. Lanzar un producto = to launch a product. Lanzarse = to dive in/take the plunge.

examples.es: El atleta lanzó el disco muy lejos.
examples.en: The athlete threw the discus very far.

notes: Salary or wage. Subida de sueldo = pay rise. Sueldo mínimo = minimum wage.

examples.es: Acaba de conseguir una subida de sueldo.
examples.en: She just got a pay rise.

notes: Multiple meanings: leaf (of a plant), sheet (of paper), blade (of a knife). Hoja de cálculo = spreadsheet. En blanco = blank sheet.

examples.es: Las hojas del árbol cambian de color en otoño.
examples.en: The tree's leaves change colour in autumn.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Votar por = to vote for. Votar en contra = to vote against. Derecho a voto = right to vote.

examples.es: Es importante votar en las elecciones.
examples.en: It's important to vote in elections.

examples.es: Su nivel de inglés es muy alto.
examples.en: Her level of English is very high.

examples.es: El uso del móvil en clase está prohibido.
examples.en: The use of mobile phones in class is forbidden.

notes: Irregular yo: convenzo (c→z before a/o). Convencer a alguien de algo = to convince someone of something. Convencerse = to convince oneself.

examples.es: Intentó convencerme de que tenía razón.
examples.en: She tried to convince me that she was right.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. ¡Es muy típico de él! = That's so typical of him! Comida típica = traditional/typical food.

examples.es: Es un plato típico de la región.
examples.en: It's a typical dish from the region.

notes: Agrees in gender/number. More respectful than viejo. Also used as a noun: el anciano/la anciana = an elderly person/man/woman.

examples.es: Ayudó a la anciana a cruzar la calle.
examples.en: He helped the elderly woman cross the street.

examples.es: El desarrollo económico del país ha sido muy rápido.
examples.en: The economic development of the country has been very fast.

notes: Recipe (cooking) or prescription (medical). Seguir una receta = to follow a recipe. Receta médica = doctor's prescription.

examples.es: ¿Me das la receta de ese pastel?
examples.en: Can you give me the recipe for that cake?

notes: Zapato de tacón = high-heeled shoe. Zapatos de deporte = sports shoes/sneakers.

examples.es: Me compré unos zapatos nuevos.
examples.en: I bought myself new shoes.

examples.es: La obra de teatro fue un gran éxito.
examples.en: The play was a great success.

notes: Stem e→i. Repito, repites, repite... Repetir una vez más = to repeat once more.

examples.es: ¿Puedes repetir la pregunta, por favor?
examples.en: Can you repeat the question, please?

notes: Compound of reír, same pattern. Sonrío, sonríes... Siempre sonríe = he/she always smiles.

examples.es: Sonrió al ver a sus amigos.
examples.en: She smiled when she saw her friends.

notes: Stem-changing (e→ie) + spelling change (g→gu before e). Negarse a = to refuse to.

examples.es: Negó haber dicho eso.
examples.en: He denied having said that.

notes: Verb in -ducir: produzco yo, strong preterite produje. Producir una película = to produce a film.

examples.es: España produce mucho aceite de oliva.
examples.en: Spain produces a lot of olive oil.

notes: Compound of hacer. Irregular yo: satisfago. Future: satisfaré. Satisfacer las necesidades = to meet needs.

examples.es: El resultado no satisface las expectativas.
examples.en: The result does not meet expectations.

notes: Irregular yo: valgo. Future: valdré. ¿Cuánto vale? = How much does it cost? Valer la pena = to be worth it.

examples.es: ¿Cuánto vale esta camisa?
examples.en: How much is this shirt?

notes: Stem e→i. Mido, mides, mide... ¿Cuánto mides? = How tall are you? Medir las consecuencias = to weigh the consequences.

examples.es: Mide casi dos metros de altura.
examples.en: He's almost two metres tall.

notes: Datos = data (plural). Datos personales = personal data/information. Base de datos = database.

examples.es: Necesito más datos para decidir.
examples.en: I need more data to decide.

notes: Verb in -uir: incluyo, incluyes... Incluido en el precio = included in the price.

examples.es: El precio incluye el desayuno.
examples.en: The price includes breakfast.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Protestar por = to protest about. La gente protestó = the people protested.

examples.es: Los estudiantes salieron a protestar.
examples.en: The students went out to protest.

notes: Verb in -ducir: traduzco, strong preterite traduje. Traducir al español = to translate into Spanish.

examples.es: Tradujo el documento del inglés al español.
examples.en: She translated the document from English into Spanish.

notes: Highly irregular. Quepo (yo). Future: cabré. ¿Cabe aquí? = Does it fit? No cabe duda = there's no doubt.

examples.es: No caben más personas en el ascensor.
examples.en: No more people can fit in the lift.

notes: Stem e→ie in present, e→i in preterite/gerund (sentir pattern). Prefiero café = I prefer coffee.

examples.es: Prefiero el café solo al café con leche.
examples.en: I prefer black coffee to coffee with milk.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Nadar a braza/crol/espalda = to swim breaststroke/crawl/backstroke.

examples.es: Aprendí a nadar cuando era niño.
examples.en: I learned to swim when I was a child.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Preparar la comida = to prepare a meal. Prepararse para = to prepare oneself for.

examples.es: Voy a preparar la cena.
examples.en: I'm going to prepare dinner.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Distinguishable from hacer la comida (to make food) — cocinar implies culinary skill or effort.

examples.es: Me encanta cocinar para mis amigos.
examples.en: I love cooking for my friends.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Gastar dinero = to spend money. Gastar energía = to use up energy. Gastarse = to wear out/run out.

examples.es: Gastó todos sus ahorros en el viaje.
examples.en: He spent all his savings on the trip.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Ahorrar dinero = to save money. Ahorrar tiempo = to save time. Ahorro (noun) = savings.

examples.es: Intento ahorrar algo de dinero cada mes.
examples.en: I try to save some money every month.

notes: Arrow (weapon or symbol). Also used for arrow signs/indicators (follow the arrows).

examples.es: Sigue las flechas hasta la salida.
examples.en: Follow the arrows to the exit.

notes: Regular -ar verb. Planear un viaje/una boda = to plan a trip/a wedding. Also: to glide (birds, planes).

examples.es: Planeamos ir de vacaciones en agosto.
examples.en: We're planning to go on holiday in August.

notes: Regular -ar but z→c before e. Organizar un evento = to organise an event. Organizarse = to get organised.

examples.es: Voy a organizar una fiesta para el sábado.
examples.en: I'm going to organise a party for Saturday.

notes: A la derecha = to the right. Gira a la derecha = turn right. Also political right: la derecha = the right wing. Adjective form: derecho/a = straight/right/upright.

examples.es: Gira a la derecha en el semáforo.
examples.en: Turn right at the traffic light.

notes: ¡Calma! / ¡Con calma! = Calm down! / Take it easy! Mantener la calma = to keep calm. Also adj: una persona muy calma = a very calm person. Calmar = to calm (verb).

examples.es: Hay que mantener la calma en situaciones difíciles.
examples.en: You have to keep calm in difficult situations.

notes: Tener respeto = to have respect. Faltar al respeto = to be disrespectful. Con todo mi respeto = with all due respect. Verb: respetar. Also: dar respeto = to command respect.

examples.es: Hay que tratar a todos con respeto.
examples.en: You have to treat everyone with respect.

notes: Tener experiencia = to have experience. Una experiencia increíble = an incredible experience. Experiencia laboral = work experience. From Latin experientia.

examples.es: Tiene mucha experiencia en ventas.
examples.en: She has a lot of experience in sales.

notes: Salida de emergencia = emergency exit. Hora de salida = departure time. Salida del sol = sunrise. No hay salida = there's no way out. Verb: salir.

examples.es: La salida del tren es a las ocho.
examples.en: The train's departure is at eight.

notes: El diablo = the devil. ¿Qué diablos...? = What the devil...? / What on earth...? Usado como exclamación informal. Pobre diablo = poor wretch. Also: diablillo = little devil.

examples.es: ¿Qué diablos estás haciendo aquí?
examples.en: What on earth are you doing here?

notes: Banda de música = musical band. Banda criminal = criminal gang. Banda sonora = soundtrack. Línea/franja (stripe). Multiple meanings depending on context.

examples.es: La banda tocó hasta la medianoche.
examples.en: The band played until midnight.

notes: Poner en acción = to put into action. Película de acción = action film. Acción = share (stock market). Acción de gracias = Thanksgiving. En acción = in action.

examples.es: Es hora de pasar a la acción.
examples.en: It's time to take action.

notes: ¡Bienvenido! = Welcome! (masculine). ¡Bienvenida! (feminine). ¡Bienvenidos! (plural). Dar la bienvenida = to welcome someone. Also used as noun: la bienvenida = the welcome.

examples.es: ¡Bienvenido a España!
examples.en: Welcome to Spain!

notes: El interior del coche = the inside of the car. Also adj: ropa interior = underwear. Ministerio del Interior = Home Office / Interior Ministry. Interior (football) = inside forward.

examples.es: El interior de la casa estaba oscuro.
examples.en: The inside of the house was dark.

notes: From Arabic inshallah. Expresses a wish. Followed by subjunctive: Ojalá venga = I hope he comes. Ojalá (que) llueva = hopefully it'll rain. One of the most characteristically Spanish expressions.

examples.es: Ojalá apruebe el examen.
examples.en: I hope I pass the exam.

notes: Estilo de vida = lifestyle. Tiene mucho estilo = she has great style. Al estilo de = in the style of. Estilo libre (natación) = freestyle. Por el estilo = something like that.

examples.es: Me gusta mucho tu estilo de vestir.
examples.en: I really like your style of dressing.

notes: Vuelo directo = direct flight. Perder el vuelo = to miss the flight. Azafata de vuelo = flight attendant. Also: en vuelo = in flight, a vuelo de pájaro = as the crow flies.

examples.es: El vuelo a Madrid dura dos horas.
examples.en: The flight to Madrid takes two hours.

notes: Two main meanings: (1) value/worth — el valor del euro; (2) courage/bravery — tener valor. Valores morales = moral values. Sin valor = worthless / cowardly.

examples.es: Tuvo mucho valor para decir la verdad.
examples.en: He showed great courage in telling the truth.

notes: Nuestro objetivo principal = our main goal. Also adj: ser objetivo = to be objective/unbiased. Objetivo de cámara = camera lens. Cumplir un objetivo = to achieve a goal.

examples.es: Su objetivo es terminar la carrera este año.
examples.en: Her goal is to finish the degree this year.

notes: Máquina de coser = sewing machine. Máquina expendedora = vending machine. A toda máquina = at full speed. Sala de máquinas = engine room. Máquina del tiempo = time machine.

examples.es: La máquina de café está rota otra vez.
examples.en: The coffee machine is broken again.

notes: Entrada principal = main entrance. Precio de entrada = admission price. Entrada gratuita = free entry. Also a ticket: comprar entradas = to buy tickets. Antonym: salida (exit).

examples.es: La entrada al museo es gratuita los domingos.
examples.en: Entry to the museum is free on Sundays.

notes: Habitación doble = double room. Doble sentido = double meaning. Al doble = twice as much. Also noun: un doble = a double (drink or lookalike). Doble de riesgo = stuntman.

examples.es: Quiero una habitación doble, por favor.
examples.en: I'd like a double room, please.

notes: Usually used in plural: los pantalones. Pantalón vaquero / vaqueros = jeans. Pantalón corto = shorts. Llevar pantalones = to wear the trousers (idiom: to be in charge).

examples.es: Se manchó el pantalón de barro.
examples.en: He got mud on his trousers.

notes: En defensa propia = in self-defence. Ministerio de Defensa = Ministry of Defence. In sport: el defensa = defender. La defensa de una tesis = thesis defence.

examples.es: El abogado preparó la defensa de su cliente.
examples.en: The lawyer prepared his client's defence.

notes: Hablar inglés = to speak English. El inglés = the English language, or an Englishman. Clase de inglés = English class. Also adjective: una palabra inglesa = an English word.

examples.es: Habla inglés con mucho acento.
examples.en: He speaks English with a strong accent.

notes: Horas de estudio = study hours. Estudio de grabación = recording studio. Apartamento estudio = studio flat. Estudios (plural) = studies/education. Verb: estudiar.

examples.es: Necesita más horas de estudio para aprobar.
examples.en: She needs more hours of study to pass.

notes: A propósito = on purpose (intentionally) OR by the way (changing topic). Con el propósito de = with the aim of. Sin propósito = aimlessly. Propósito de año nuevo = New Year's resolution.

examples.es: Lo hizo a propósito para molestarme.
examples.en: He did it on purpose to annoy me.

notes: Two main meanings: (1) unit of length — un metro de tela = a metre of fabric; (2) underground railway — coger el metro = to take the subway/tube. Metro cuadrado = square metre.

examples.es: Cogemos el metro para ir al centro.
examples.en: We take the subway to get to the centre.

notes: Hacer una visita = to pay a visit. Visita guiada = guided tour. Visita médica = doctor's appointment. Tener visita = to have guests. Verb: visitar.

examples.es: Mañana tenemos visita en casa.
examples.en: We have guests coming to the house tomorrow.

notes: As verb: pesar = to weigh (¿Cuánto pesas? = How much do you weigh?). As noun: un pesar = a regret/sorrow. A pesar de = despite/in spite of — one of the most useful Spanish phrases.

examples.es: A pesar del frío, salimos a caminar.
examples.en: Despite the cold, we went out for a walk.

notes: En absoluto = not at all (a very common phrase): ¿Te molesta? — En absoluto = Does it bother you? — Not at all. Poder absoluto = absolute power. Silencio absoluto = complete silence.

examples.es: ¿Te importa si me siento aquí? — En absoluto.
examples.en: Do you mind if I sit here? — Not at all.

notes: Al contrario = on the contrary. Todo lo contrario = quite the opposite. De lo contrario = otherwise. En sentido contrario = in the opposite direction. Also noun: el contrario = the opponent.

examples.es: Al contrario de lo que pensaba, fue fácil.
examples.en: Contrary to what I thought, it was easy.

notes: Coger/tomar un taxi = to take a taxi. Parar un taxi = to hail a cab. Taxista = taxi driver. The same word in most languages. Invariable plural: los taxis.

examples.es: Voy a pedir un taxi para llegar al aeropuerto.
examples.en: I'm going to order a taxi to get to the airport.

notes: La red = the internet/web. Red social = social network. Red de carreteras = road network. Caer en la red = to fall into the net (literal or figurative). Short: la red (web).

examples.es: Lo encontré buscando en la red.
examples.en: I found it by searching on the web.

notes: Tomar un trago = to have a drink. Un trago amargo = a bitter pill (idiom). De un trago = in one gulp. Informal for any alcoholic drink in Latin America. Tragos = drinks (at a bar).

examples.es: ¿Tomamos un trago después del trabajo?
examples.en: Shall we have a drink after work?

notes: Cepillarse los dientes = to brush your teeth. Diente de leche = milk tooth. Diente de ajo = clove of garlic. Dolor de muelas = toothache (muela = molar). Dentista = dentist.

examples.es: Hay que cepillarse los dientes después de cada comida.
examples.en: You have to brush your teeth after every meal.

notes: Three main uses: (1) military rank — cabo = corporal; (2) geography — el Cabo de Buena Esperanza; (3) al cabo de = after (a period of time). Llevar a cabo = to carry out (very common phrase).

examples.es: Llevamos a cabo el plan sin problemas.
examples.en: We carried out the plan without any problems.

notes: Lucha libre = freestyle wrestling. La lucha por la igualdad = the fight for equality. Luchar = to fight/struggle (verb). Lucha de clases = class struggle.

examples.es: La lucha contra la pobreza requiere esfuerzo global.
examples.en: The fight against poverty requires global effort.

notes: A menudo = often (the main use). As adj: menudo = small/petty. ¡Menudo lío! = What a mess! (ironic intensifier). Menudo = tripe (food). The adverbial phrase a menudo is the most learnable usage.

examples.es: A menudo me olvido de las llaves.
examples.en: I often forget my keys.

notes: Conseguir la victoria = to achieve victory. Victoria aplastante = crushing victory. Cantar victoria = to celebrate prematurely. From Latin victoria. Also a common female name.

examples.es: El equipo celebró su victoria en el campeonato.
examples.en: The team celebrated their victory in the championship.

notes: La prensa = the press/newspapers. Conferencia de prensa = press conference. Libertad de prensa = freedom of the press. Prensa del corazón = tabloid press. Also a physical press (machine).

examples.es: La noticia apareció en toda la prensa nacional.
examples.en: The news appeared in all the national press.

notes: Past participle of sentar used as adjective.

examples.es: Estaba sentado en el banco del parque.
examples.en: He was sitting on the park bench.

examples.es: Permanezca sentado hasta que aterrice el avión.
examples.en: Please remain seated until the plane lands.

notes: Informal term for father, common across Latin America.

examples.es: ¡Papi, ven a jugar conmigo!
examples.en: Daddy, come play with me!

examples.es: Papi me compró un helado.
examples.en: Dad bought me an ice cream.

notes: Form of address for a judge or member of parliament. 'Su Señoría' = Your Honor.

examples.es: Señoría, solicito la palabra.
examples.en: Your Honor, I request the floor.

examples.es: Su señoría ha dictado sentencia.
examples.en: His Lordship has passed sentence.

notes: In Latin America: potato. Capitalized 'Papa' = the Pope. 'papá' (with accent) = dad.

examples.es: Voy a comprar papas para la cena.
examples.en: I'm going to buy potatoes for dinner.

examples.es: El papa viajó a América Latina.
examples.en: The Pope traveled to Latin America.

notes: Can mean 'familiar' (well-known) or 'family-related'. As noun: 'un familiar' = a relative.

examples.es: Ese rostro me resulta muy familiar.
examples.en: That face looks very familiar to me.

examples.es: Es un ambiente familiar muy agradable.
examples.en: It is a very pleasant family atmosphere.

notes: Can refer to police inspector or any official inspector. Feminine: inspectora.

examples.es: El inspector llegó al lugar del crimen.
examples.en: The inspector arrived at the crime scene.

examples.es: La inspectora interrogó a los testigos.
examples.en: The inspector questioned the witnesses.

notes: Used as adjective ('el total') or adverb ('en total'). Colloquially 'total' = 'anyway / in short'.

examples.es: El costo total es de cien euros.
examples.en: The total cost is one hundred euros.

examples.es: En total, asistieron cien personas.
examples.en: In total, a hundred people attended.

notes: Most common in the plural 'huellas'. 'Huellas dactilares' = fingerprints.

examples.es: La policía encontró huellas en la escena del crimen.
examples.en: The police found fingerprints at the crime scene.

examples.es: Dejó una huella profunda en mi vida.
examples.en: He left a deep impression on my life.

notes: Can mean a unit (measurement/military/product) or unity/cohesion.

examples.es: La unidad del equipo fue clave para ganar.
examples.en: The team's unity was key to winning.

examples.es: Compré dos unidades del producto.
examples.en: I bought two units of the product.

notes: From 'tonto' (stupid/fool). Often used in plural 'tonterías'.

examples.es: No digas tonterías.
examples.en: Don't talk nonsense.

examples.es: Pelearon por una tontería.
examples.en: They fought over a silly thing.

notes: 'Parque de atracciones' = amusement park. 'Parque nacional' = national park.

examples.es: Los niños juegan en el parque.
examples.en: The children play in the park.

examples.es: El parque nacional tiene una fauna increíble.
examples.en: The national park has incredible wildlife.

notes: Can mean rest, a break, or half-time in a sports match.

examples.es: Necesito un descanso, estoy agotado.
examples.en: I need a rest, I'm exhausted.

examples.es: Tenemos diez minutos de descanso.
examples.en: We have ten minutes of break.

notes: Can refer to any performance or an impressive sight. 'Dar un espectáculo' = to make a scene.

examples.es: El espectáculo duró dos horas.
examples.en: The show lasted two hours.

examples.es: Fue todo un espectáculo verlos bailar.
examples.en: Watching them dance was quite a spectacle.

notes: Derived from 'bello' (beautiful). 'Salón de belleza' = beauty salon.

examples.es: La belleza del paisaje nos dejó sin palabras.
examples.en: The beauty of the landscape left us speechless.

examples.es: Es una belleza de persona.
examples.en: She is a beautiful person.

notes: Past participle of abrir used as adjective. 'Estar abierto' = to be open (shop, etc.).

examples.es: La puerta está abierta.
examples.en: The door is open.

examples.es: Es una persona muy abierta y sociable.
examples.en: She is a very open and sociable person.

notes: Can be used as an adjective or noun ('el borracho' = the drunk). Feminine: borracha.

examples.es: No conduzcas si estás borracho.
examples.en: Don't drive if you are drunk.

examples.es: Estaba tan borracho que no se tenía en pie.
examples.en: He was so drunk he could barely stand up.

notes: 'Firmar un contrato' = to sign a contract. 'Contrato de trabajo' = employment contract.

examples.es: Firmé un contrato de trabajo de un año.
examples.en: I signed a one-year employment contract.

examples.es: El contrato vence el próximo mes.
examples.en: The contract expires next month.

notes: Day of the week. Does not change in the plural ('los viernes' = on Fridays).

examples.es: La reunión es el viernes a las tres.
examples.en: The meeting is on Friday at three.

examples.es: ¡Por fin es viernes!
examples.en: It's finally Friday!

notes: 'Carga de trabajo' = workload. Also the charge on a battery or weapon.

examples.es: El camión transporta una carga muy pesada.
examples.en: The truck is carrying a very heavy load.

examples.es: El cuidado de los niños supone una gran carga.
examples.en: Looking after the children is a great burden.

notes: Also used as noun: 'el presente' = the present tense/moment. 'Estar presente' = to be present.

examples.es: ¿Hay alguien que no esté presente?
examples.en: Is there anyone who is not present?

examples.es: Tengo muy presente lo que me dijiste.
examples.en: I keep very much in mind what you told me.

notes: 'En oferta' = on sale/on offer. 'Oferta de trabajo' = job offer.

examples.es: El supermercado tiene muchas ofertas hoy.
examples.en: The supermarket has lots of deals today.

examples.es: Hizo una oferta de trabajo muy atractiva.
examples.en: He made a very attractive job offer.

notes: Opposite of 'rápido/deprisa'. Can also be used as an adjective in some regions.

examples.es: Habla más despacio, por favor.
examples.en: Please speak more slowly.

examples.es: Conduce despacio por la zona escolar.
examples.en: Drive slowly through the school zone.

notes: Used as both adjective and noun: 'un profesional' = a professional.

examples.es: Tiene una actitud muy profesional.
examples.en: She has a very professional attitude.

examples.es: Es futbolista profesional desde los dieciocho años.
examples.en: He has been a professional footballer since he was eighteen.

notes: Borrowed from English 'leader'. Masculine and feminine forms are the same.

examples.es: Es el líder del partido político.
examples.en: He is the leader of the political party.

examples.es: El equipo va líder en la clasificación.
examples.en: The team is leading in the standings.

notes: 'Piedra angular' = cornerstone. 'De piedra' = stone (adj), also slang for speechless/shocked.

examples.es: Me cayó una piedra en el pie.
examples.en: A stone fell on my foot.

examples.es: Construyeron el castillo con piedra local.
examples.en: They built the castle with local stone.

notes: 'Tener la intención de' = to intend to. 'Con buena/mala intención' = with good/bad intent.

examples.es: No era mi intención hacerte daño.
examples.en: It wasn't my intention to hurt you.

examples.es: Lo hizo con buena intención.
examples.en: He did it with good intentions.

notes: 'Estar de buen/mal humor' = to be in a good/bad mood. Also means humour (comedy).

examples.es: Hoy está de muy buen humor.
examples.en: He is in a very good mood today.

examples.es: Tiene un gran sentido del humor.
examples.en: She has a great sense of humour.

notes: Can mean central (location) or main/key. As noun: 'la central' = headquarters/power station.

examples.es: Vive en el barrio más central de la ciudad.
examples.en: He lives in the most central neighbourhood of the city.

examples.es: La central eléctrica abastece a toda la región.
examples.en: The power station supplies the entire region.

notes: As noun: public prosecutor (Spain). As adjective: fiscal/tax-related.

examples.es: El fiscal pidió diez años de prisión.
examples.en: The prosecutor requested ten years in prison.

examples.es: El año fiscal termina en diciembre.
examples.en: The fiscal year ends in December.

notes: Invariable — does not change for gender or number. 'De gratis' is colloquial.

examples.es: La entrada al museo es gratis los domingos.
examples.en: Museum admission is free on Sundays.

examples.es: Te lo arreglo gratis.
examples.en: I'll fix it for you for free.

notes: From 'amenazar' (to threaten). 'Bajo amenaza' = under threat.

examples.es: Recibió amenazas de muerte.
examples.en: He received death threats.

examples.es: El cambio climático es una amenaza real.
examples.en: Climate change is a real threat.

notes: 'Marca registrada' = registered trademark. Also a record/score in sports.

examples.es: ¿De qué marca es tu teléfono?
examples.en: What brand is your phone?

examples.es: Batió la marca mundial de los cien metros.
examples.en: She broke the world record for the hundred metres.

notes: Synonym of 'empezar'. Stem-changing: comienza, comienzo. Slightly more formal.

examples.es: La clase comienza a las nueve.
examples.en: The class begins at nine.

examples.es: ¿Cuándo comenzaste a estudiar español?
examples.en: When did you start studying Spanish?

notes: 'Medicina general' = general practice. Also the act of taking medicine: 'tomar la medicina'.

examples.es: Estudió medicina durante seis años.
examples.en: She studied medicine for six years.

examples.es: Toma esta medicina dos veces al día.
examples.en: Take this medicine twice a day.

notes: 'Tener acceso a' = to have access to. 'Acceso directo' = shortcut (computing).

examples.es: No tienes acceso a esta área.
examples.en: You don't have access to this area.

examples.es: El acceso a internet es fundamental hoy.
examples.en: Access to the internet is fundamental today.

notes: 'En caso de necesidad' = if necessary. 'Por necesidad' = out of necessity.

examples.es: No hay necesidad de gritar.
examples.en: There is no need to shout.

examples.es: El agua es una necesidad básica.
examples.en: Water is a basic necessity.

notes: Feminine: dueña. 'Ser dueño de' = to own. 'Ser dueño de sí mismo' = to be self-controlled.

examples.es: ¿Quién es el dueño de este coche?
examples.en: Who is the owner of this car?

examples.es: La dueña del restaurante es muy amable.
examples.en: The restaurant owner is very friendly.

notes: Invariable for gender. 'Acoso sexual' = sexual harassment. 'Educación sexual' = sex education.

examples.es: El acoso sexual es una forma de violencia.
examples.en: Sexual harassment is a form of violence.

examples.es: Recibió educación sexual en el colegio.
examples.en: She received sex education at school.

notes: Masculine noun despite ending in -a. Also used informally: 'ser un fantasma' = to be a no-show/boaster.

examples.es: El niño dice que vio un fantasma.
examples.en: The boy says he saw a ghost.

examples.es: Es un fantasma, nunca aparece cuando lo necesitas.
examples.en: He's a ghost, he never shows up when you need him.

notes: Plural-only in this meaning. Singular 'vario' is rare; use 'varios' for 'several'.

examples.es: Te he llamado varios días seguidos.
examples.en: I've called you several days in a row.

examples.es: Hay varias razones para hacerlo.
examples.en: There are several reasons to do it.

notes: '¡Felicidades!' = Congratulations! 'La felicidad' (uncountable) = happiness as a state.

examples.es: El dinero no compra la felicidad.
examples.en: Money can't buy happiness.

examples.es: Sus ojos brillaban de felicidad.
examples.en: Her eyes shone with happiness.
